1160: Vela sage mibbar nash chad. umean atar itnesivu meinnun kuppin devaazara natlin agra, veayyte lehu meinnun dame dahavo mikkullehu.

Vehahu seira ochora, dehava ishtear lekudesha berich hu, avdin leh chattat bekadmita. veha okimna bean atar hava mitkashshera. ulevatar da mitkarvin hane, umitbassemin kolla, veishtaaru yisrael zakkain kame kudesha berich hu, mikkol chovin deavdu vechavu kameh. hada hu dichtiv ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem vegomer.

Tu amar ribbi shimon, (Bereshit 27:11) vayyomer yaakov el rivka immo hen esav achi ish sair veanochi ish chalak. may ka remiza, ella vadday esav ish sair, hu mehahu deikre sair, deha mehahu sitra ate. veanochi ish chalak: gevar mehahu defalig lechol shear ammin ravrevin memanan. dichtiv, (Devarim 4:19) asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam, uchetiv (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer. tu ish chalak, mittere seirim veishtear chada. dechahana palig le, chad lechulakeh, vechad lekudesha berich hu. amay. begin deyatin al katpoy kol chovoy deyaakov, dichtiv venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam, avonot tam.

Tana, behahu yoma kama pitchin petichan lokovlehon deyisrael lekabbela tzelotehon. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deha kudesha berich hu baa lezakkaa lon, uledakkea lon, hada hu dichtiv ki vayyom hazze yechapper vegomer. behay yoma itattar kahana bechamma itrin. behay yoma pulechana dechahana yakkira verav mikkol pulechanin. lecholla yahav chulaka beinnun karbenin dekudesha berich hu. behay yoma itattar (sefer acher ittear) chesed bealma al yeda dechahana, mekarev karbenin al chovehon deamma. al choveh bekadmita, ulevatar al chovehon deamma. mekarev illavavn aleh veal amma veha okimna mille.

Ad dahavo azle, yatvu bechad chakal, vetzallu. nachat chad anana deeshsha, veaschar lon. amar ribbi shimon, ha chamena dekudesha berich hu reuta dileh hacha. netiv. yatvu vahavu amre mille deorayyta. patach veamar, (Mishlei 25:25) mayim karim al nefesh ayefa ushemua tova meeretz merchak, ha istakkalna bemilloy dishlomo malka, vechullehu (sefer acher bechachmeta) bechachma amaran.

Ta chaze 3 sifrin dechachmeta appik shelomo lealma, vechullehu bechachmeta illaa. shir hashshirim chachma, kohelet tevuna, umishle daat. lokovel 3 illen, avad 3 sefarim. shir hashshirim keneged chachma hache hu. kohelet lekavel tevuna, hache hu. mishle lekavel daat. bemay itchaze. ella chol innun kerae bitre gevavne innun, resha vesefa tere gevavne itchazyay. vechad mistakkele kerae, da kelil beda, veda kelil beda, begin kach shakil lokovleh dedaat.

Hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh. vechad istakkalna beh, kolla kalil chad bechad, ben misefeh leresheh, ben meresheh lesefeh. shemua tova meeretz merchak mayim karim al nefesh ayefa. mayim karim al nefesh ayefa ushemua tova meeretz merchak, veda veda nayycha derucha, kema dehay nayycha derucha, kach hay nayycha derucha.

Ad dahavo yatve, ata chad bar nash, amar, intu deribbi shimon attesiat mimmaraha. vechavrayyay shamu kala, dekudesha berich hu shavak leinnun chove dedara. amar ribbi shimon, ha itkayyaym hacha kera, ushemua tova meeretz merchak, hachi hu nayycha derucha, kemo mayim karim al nefesh ayefa. amar lehu nekum venezil dekudesha berich hu archish lan benissin.

Patach veamar, mayim karim al nefesh ayefa, da orayyta. dechol man dezache lemile beorayyta, umeravi nafsha minnah, ma ketiv ushemua tova meeretz merchak. kudesha berich hu achriz aleh kama tavan leotava leh bealma den uvealma deate. hada hu dichtiv, ushemua tova, man atar meeretz merchak, meatar dekudesha berich hu hava rachik minneh bekadmita, meatar dehava bar nash bidvavu immeh bekadmita, dichtiv, (Iyov 20:27) veeretz mitkomama lo, mehahu atar
1161: Makdimin leh shelam, hada hu dichtiv, meeretz merchak. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li veahavat olam ahavtich al ken meshachtich chased.

(Kan chaser) (Vayikra 16:18) veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai vechipper alav. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 50:1) mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai dibber vayyikra aretz mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo. tana, elef vachamesh mea vechamshin ribbo mare shirata, mezammerin lekudesha berich hu, kad nahir yemama. veelef vachamesh mea vearbein utemanya betihara. veelef vachamesh mea vetishin elef ribbo behahi shaata deikre ben haarbayim.

Ribbi yose amar, kad nahir yemama, kol innun mare divava, meshabbechan bemile tushebchan, lokovleh dehay boker. (sefer acher kad ittear, dechad) dechad ittear hay boker, kullehu mitvassemin, vedina ishtechich, veamrin tushebchan. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim. vehahu zimna, (hemanuta) chedvavta uvirkan mishtakkechin bealma, vekudesha berich hu ittear leavraham leachayay leh, veishtaasha beh, veashleteh bealma. umena lan dehay boker deavraham hu. dichtiv (Bereshit 19:27) vayyashkem avraham babboker.

Behahu zimna deven haarbayim, kol innun elef vachamesh mea vetishin elef ribbo mare dilala ikrun, umezammerin behahi shaata, uketatuta sharya bealma, vehahi shaata ittearuta deittear kudesha berich hu leyitzchak, vekam vedain lechayyayvayya deavrin al pitgame orayyta, veshiva nahare eshsha nagdin venafkin vechalin al reshehon derashiayyay, veshalhove gumerin denura mitarin meella letatta, ucheden tav avraham leatreh. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 18:33) veavraham shav limkomo. veyoma itpene, vechayyayve gehinnam tzavvchin veamrin (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki pana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. vehahi shaata, bae bar nash leizdahara, bitzlota demincha.

Bezimna demate lelya innun elef vaAdonai mea vearbein utemanya, ikrun mibbara lefarochta, veamrin shirata. keden dinin diltatta mitarin, veazlin veshatin bealma, veillen amrin shirata. ad deyitpelig lelya mishmara ufalga. batar deyitpelig lelya mizdamne kullehu acharine kachada, veamre tehillot, kema deat amer (yeshaya 60) utehillot Adonai yevasseru. ribbi yehuda amar kad raava ishtechach betzafra, tehillot Adonai mevasserin.
Ribbi yose amar, batar derucha detzafon ittear befalgut lelya veazil leh, tehillot mevassere, ad deyete tzafra, veittear hay boker, keden chedvavta uvirkan ishtechach bealma.

Tana, amar ribbi abba, kullehu hachi, veella minnehon sarchin telata. behahi shaata deittear hay boker, umitarin tushebchan, kol innun elef vachamesh mea vechamshin ribbo, itmana alayyhu chad memana, veheman shemeh lokovle diltatta, utechot yedeh sarchin memanan alayyhu leatkena shirata.

Behahi shaata deittear zimna deven haarbayim, vezamrin kol innun elef vachamesh mea vetishin elef ribbo mare dilala, itmana alayyhu chad memana vidutun shemeh, lokovleh diltatta, utechot yedeh sarchin memanan alayyhu, leatkena hahu zimra, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 25:5) zemir aritzim.

Behahi shaata demate lelya, mitarin kol innun demibbara lefarochta, keden shachich kolla, ufitra la ishtechach, vedinin diltatta mitarin, kullehu itmanan kachada, illen al illen, ad deitpelig lelya. batar deitpelig lelya, umitkanneshe kullehu, itmana alayyhu chad memana vechanish lechol mashshiryayn, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 10:25) meassef lechol hammachanot vegomer, veasaf shemeh, lokovleh diltatta, utechot yedeh kol innun sarchin memanan, umevassere tehillot.

Ad deate tzafra, kevan deate tzafra, kam hahu naar, yonek mishshede immeh, ledakkea lehu, veal leshammesha. kad ittear boker, keden hi shaata deraava, deishtae matronita bemalka, umalka mashich minneh chad
1162: Chuta devirkan ufaris al matronita, veal innun demizdavvevge le. man innun demizdavvevge imme. innun demishtaddele beorayyta belelya, kad itpelag.

Ribbi shimon amar, zakkaa chulakeh man deate im matronita, beshaata deatat lekabbela anpe malka, leishtae beh. veishtechach immah. beshaata deoshit malka yemina, lekabbela lematronita. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:9) essa kanfe shachar eshkena beacharit yam. may acharit yam. hahi shaata acharit dehahu yam hu. dechad itpelag, sheruta hava, vedina hava, vehasheta acharit hu dilah, demistallekin dinaha. vealat begadpoy demalka, hi vechol innun demizdavvevgin le, hada hu dichtiv eshkena beacharit yam.

Vetana, kol innun demishtaddele beorayyta beshaata deitpelig lelya. ishtetaf bishchinta. vechad ate tzafra, umatronita itchabberat im malka, hu ishtechach immah im malka. umalka peres al kullehu gadpoy, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi vegomer.

Tana, behahi shaata, avahan mizdammenin bematronita, vekaddemin leishtae bahadah, uleitchabbera immah. vekudesha berich hu mallil immah behu. vehu kare lah lefarsa lah gadpoy, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 50:1) mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai dibber vayikra aretz vegomer. el: da nehiru dechachmeta, veikre chesed. elohim: da gevura. Adonai: da shelimu dechalla, rachame. veal da, dibber vayikra aretz vegomer.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ kameh derabbi shimon avoy, amar leh, ha tanenan elohim bechol atar dina hu. yod hei vav hei. it atar deikre elohim, kegon (Bereshit 15) adonay Adonai. amay ikre elohim, veha atvavn rachame innun bechol atar.

Amar leh, hachi hu ketiv bakkera, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:39) veyadata hayyom vehashevota el levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim, uchetiv (Melachim 1 18:39-40) Adonai hu haelohim. amar leh milla da yedana, devaatar deit dina, it rachame. ulezimna, baatar deit rachame, it dina, amar leh ta chaze dehachi hu, Adonai bechol atar rachame. uveshaata dimhappeche chayyayvayya rachame ledina, keden ketiv Adonai, vekarenan leh elohim.

Aval ta chaze raza demilla, 3 dargin innun, vechol darga vedarga bilchodoy, veaf al gav decholla chad, umitkashshere bechad, vela mitparshe da min da. ta chaze, kullehu netian, vechol innun butzinin demitlahatin kullehu nehirin umitlahatan umishtakyayn umitbarchan, mehahu nahara denagid venafik, decholla kalil beh, (tere navesachey) uchelala decholla beh.

Vehay nahara itkere em leginta, veella migginta, begin deeden mishtattef bahadah, vela parish (sefer acher amud bet) minnah. uvegin kach, kol mabbuin nafkin venagdin veishtakyayn lechol ivar. ufatchin bah petichan, veal da rachame minnah mishtakkechin, verachamin petichin bah.

Uvegin dekarenan lah em, nukeba gevura, vedina minnah nafik. ikre rachame bilchodaha, ha missitraha dinin mitarin. uvegin kach ketiv berachame, venakud bedina. atvavn berachame, veitnegid dina missitraha, kegavvna da Adonai, hay darga chad.

Darga tinyayna, missitra dehay kadmaa, nafik veittear darga ochora ikre gevura, vehay ikre elohim, beillen atvavn mammash. veshiruta (chad) mizzeer anpin hu, uveh itachid. uvegin deitachid (hay) behay, ketiv Adonai haelohim, ki Adonai hu haelohim, beillen atvavn, vehu chad, veda hu darga tinyayna.

Darga telitaa, tzedek. kitra batraa, hay be dina demalka. vetana adonay hachi ketiv, vehachi ikre, ukkeneset yisrael behay shema itkere. vehay shema baatar da ishtelim. veillen innun 3 dargin, deikrun bishmehon dedina. vecholla mitkashshar chad bechad bela piruda, kema deokimna.

Amar leh, i nicha kammeh deabba, ha shemana behay, (18 amud alef) dichtiv, (Shemot 3:14) ehye asher ehye, vela kayyma beh. amar leh elazar beri, ha okmuha chavrayyay, vehasheta bechad milla itkeshar kolla.
1163: Veraza demilla hachi hu. ehye, da kelala decholla. dechad shevilin setimin vela mitparshan, uchelilan bechad atar. keden ikre ehye, kelala kolla, satim vela itgalyay.

Batar denafak minneh sheruta, vehahu nahar itabbar leamshacha kolla, keden ikre asher ehye. kelomar, al ken ehye, ehye zammin leamshacha uleolada kolla. ehye: kelomar, hasheta ana hu kelal kolla, kelala dechol perata. asher ehye: deitabberat imma, vezaminat leappaka peratin kullehu, uleitgalyay shema illaa.

Levatar baa moshe leminda perata demilla man hu, ad defarish veamar ehye (sefer acher Adonai), da hu perata, vehacha la ketiv asher ehye. (vaychi 135) veashkachna besifra dishlomo malka, asher: bekitura deidduna kastira bechavruta illaa ishtechach. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 30:13) beashri ki ishsheruni banot, ehye zemina leolada.

Ta chaze hech nachit middarga ledarga, leodaa raza dishma kaddisha (leachazaa kudesha berich hu) lemoshe. bekadmita ehye, kelala decholla, satim dela itgalyay kelal, kema daamena. vesiman, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye etzlo amon vegomer, uchetiv (Iyov 28:13) lo yada enosh erkah vegomer. levatar appik (raza desheruta ilaa, reshita decholla 6) hahu nahara, imma illaa, itabberat, uzemina leolada. veamar asher ehye, zemina leolada, uletakkena kolla. levatar share leolada, vela ketiv asher, ella ehye: kelomar, hasheta yafik veyittakan kolla.

Batar denafik kolla, veittakkan kol chad vechad beatreh, shavak kolla, veamar Adonai. da perata, veda kiuma. uvehahi shaata yada moshe, raza dishma kaddisha, satim vegalya veitdabbak ma dela itdavaku shear bene alma, zakkaa chulakeh. ata ribbi elazar venashik yedoy.

Amar leh, elazar beri, mikkan ulehala, izdehar dela lemichtav shema kaddisha, ella kedka yeot. dechol man dela yada lemichtav shema kaddisha kedka yeot, ulekashshera kishra dimhemnuta kishra dechad bechad, begin leyachada shema kaddisha. aleh ketiv, (Bamidbar 15:31) ki devar Adonai baza veet mitzvato hefar hikkaret tikkaret vegomer. afillu degara chad darga, o chad kishra, meat chad minnayyhu.

Ta chaze, 10 bekadmita, kelala decholla, satim mikkol sitrin, shevilin la mitfattechin, kelala didchar venukeba. kotza deyod dilella, remiza leayin. levatar, 10 deappik hahu nahara denagid venafik mineh, uleitabbera minneh Adonai, behay ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. (Shemot 83 amud alef) yotze vela yatza. begin kach la baya leitparsha mineh. uvegin kach ketiv rayati.

Vei tema nahar ketiv, mashma chad, veha hacha 3. hachi hu vday, 10 appik telata, uvitlata itkelal kolla. 10 appik lekammeh hahu nahar, uteren benin deyanka lehu imma, veitabberat minnayyhu, veappik lon levatar. Adonai: kegavvna da Adonai, veinnun benin techot abba veima.

Batar deolidat, appikat ben dechar, veshavyeh lekammah, uvae lemichtav 6, vehay yarit achasanta deabba veima, veyarit teren chulakin, uminneh ittezan berata. veal da, bae lemichtav levatar, 11 kachada kema dehe kadmaa 15 kachada, vela bae leafresha lon, uf hacha 11 kachada, vela bae leafresha lon. veha okimna mille. velaatar ochora sallekin hane mile. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyadin razin illain demalka kaddisha, veyitchazun leodaa leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha.

Tana amar ribbi yehuda, (Tehillim 50:1) el elohim Adonai dibber vayikra aretz. shelimu decholla, shelimu daavahan kaddishe. dibber vayyikra aretz, leishtakkecha bikkeneset yisrael bishlimu bechedvavta. umean atar hu ishtechach immah. hadar veamar, mitztziyyon michlal yofi elohim hofia.

Tana kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma diltatta, kolla kegavvna dilella avad leh. avad yerushelem, emtzaita dechol ara. vaatar chad deikre tziyyon, ala. umehay atar mitbarcha. uvehay atar detziyyon share alma leitbanaa, uminneh itbene. hada hu dichtiv, el elohim Adonai dibber vayyikra aretz mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo. umean atar. mitztziyyon michlal yofi
1164: Elohim hofia. kelomar, mitziyyon dehu shelimu deyofi dealma, elohim hofia. ta chaze, la itbarcha yerushalam, ella mitztziyyon. vetziyyon meella, vecholla chad bechad itkeshar.

Tana, amar ribbi yehuda, (Vayikra 16:18) veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai vechipper alav. el hammizbeach setam. (kivyachol) kema deitavid letatta, itavid leella, vecholla itkeshar chad bechad. vetana, kema divhay yoma mechapper kahana letatta, hachi name leella. vechad kahana diltatta mesadder pulechaneh, kahana dilella hachi name, (kivyachol) la ishtechach leella, ed deishtechach letatta. umittatta share lesalleka kedushsha demalka illaa, umishtachchin kullehu almin chad kammeh dekudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi yehuda, ilmale havo yadi yisrael amay kudesha berich hu pakid alayyhu deyisrael, leochacha lehu yattir mikkol shear ammin, yindeun deha kudesha berich hu shavik dideh, vela gave minnehon chad mimmea. tana, kudesha berich hu kama retichin, kama chayyaylin it leh, kama shuletanin memanan mishtakkechin befulechaneh, kad zammin lehu leyisrael behay alma, achtar lon bechitrin kaddishin kegavvna dilella, ashre lon beara kaddisha, begin deyishtechachu befulechaneh, kashir lechullehu illae behu beyisrael.

Vechedvavn la alin kammeh, ufulechana la itavid kameh leella, ad deyisrael avdin letatta. kol zimna deyisrael mishtakkechin befulechaneh demarehon letatta, hachi name leella. (kivyachol) bezimna deyisrael betalle pulechana letatta. betalle leella, ufulechana la ishtechach la leella vela letatta. veal deyisrael batlu pulechana dekudesha berich hu kad sharan beara, hachi name leella, kol shekken levatar.

Amar kudesha berich hu, yisrael i attun yadin, kama uchelusin, kama chayyaylin, mitakkevin beginayychu, tindeun delet attun keday lemekam bealma, afillu shaata chada. veim kol da ma ketiv, (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem lo meastim velo gealtim vegomer, (begin kach) veyatza el hammizbeach, el hammizbeach setam, asher lifne Adonai setam. vechipper alav levatar, veyatza veasa et olato veet olat haam vegomer. vechipper alav may ka mayyre. amar ribbi yose, leitteara chesed bealma bekadmita.

Tana, ketiv vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael. may vechipper al hakkodesh. ella amar ribbi elazar, ha tanenan, chayyayvayya avdin pegimuta leella, umitarin dinin, vegarmin leistaava makdesha. vechivya takkifa share leitgallaa. ucheden dinin mitarin bealma, uvehay yoma, bae kahana ledakkea kolla, uleitattera (sefer acher uleitara) kitra kaddisha dileh, dehi resha demalka. begin deyete malka leashraa bematronita, vechad resha demalka natil, kolla natil, veyete leizdavvevga bematronita uleatara chedu uvirkan bealma. (sefer acher begin deyete malka leizdavvevga bematronita uleitara chidu uvirkan bealma, vechad resha demalka natil kolla natil)

Ishtechach dechol shelama (nusach acher shelimu) deella vetatta, bechahana talyay. dei ittear kitra dileh, kolla ittear vecholla bishlimu ishtechach. veal da ketiv vechipper al hakkodesh. bekadmita vechipper al hakkodesh. leasgaa shelama bealma, uleasgaa chedu bealma. vechad chedu deziuuga ishtechach bemalka ubbematronita, kol shammashin, vechol bene hechala, kullehu ishtechachu bechedu (vechad chedu dealma). vechol chovin dechavu kame malka, itkappar lehu. hada hu dichtiv, mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. uvegin kach ketiv vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh ad tzeto. beshaata deal lezavvevga lehu, uveshaata demizdavvevgin malka umatronita, hahi shaata vechipper baado uvead beto.

Tana, (Vayikra 16:17) vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed, ribbi yitzchak patach, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov veaf et beriti yitzchak vegomer, vehay kera ukemuha. ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael begaluta, kivyachol kudesha berich hu immehon begaluta, deha shechinta la itade minnayyhu lealmin. ta chaze, bezimna deyisrael ishtechachu begaluta devavel, shechinta benayyhu sharya, vetavat immehon min galuta. uvizchut innun tzaddikayyay
1165: Deishtaaru beara, sharat beara, vela ade minnayyhu lealmin. amar ribbi yehuda, deithadderat matronita bemalka, veithaddar kolla behillula demalka, begin kach ikrun anshe keneset haggedola, keneset haggedola vadday.

Tana, bechol zimna deyisrael begaluta, i innun zakkain, kudesha berich hu akdim lerachama alayyhu, uleappaka lon miggaluta. vei innun la zakkain, meakkev lon begaluta, ad hahu zimna deitgezar. vechad mata zimna, veinnun la itchazyayn, kudesha berich hu ashgach likara dishme, vela anshe lehu begaluta, hada hu dichtiv vezacharti et beriti yaakov vegomer. illen avahan decholla, raza dishma kaddisha.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, may taama yaakov kadmaa hacha. ella, begin deyaakov kelala daavahan, vehu ilana kaddisha. begin kach, 6 dishma kaddisha beh achida, vehachi karenan yaakov bev. ribbi yitzchak, amar vav beatvoy 13 mechilan, deyarit yeruta deyg mabbuin demabbua setima kaddisha.

Ribbi abba amar, vav amay kalil 6 1 6. ella, 6 deyativ al kuresyay, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala. 1 satim begavvih vela itgalyay, veda hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:16) bi nishbati (130 amud alef) neum Adonai, begin kach ketiv, vela ikre, batraa, kelala dekadmaa. batraa, ha okimna (nusach acher batraa kelala 10 kadmaa 6 batraa) da yesod, deihu siyyuma degufa, uchelala dileh. veal da kelilan atvavn da beda, vav, resha vesiyyuma, kema deokimna.

Vetana, teren atvavn innun, kehay gavvna vav daamena, nun uf hachi. veaf al gav deukemuha milla, nun hachi mitparsha: 50 kefufa, da matronita. usemicha lah 6, deihu yesod, begin leitbarcha minneh. 50 peshuta, itpashshetuta detiferet. veal da kelilan atvavn, umitachadan da beda. vei tema, amay ahdar 6 anpoy minnun kefufa, veahdar anpoy legabbe 50 peshuta. ella begin yekara demalka, ahdar anpoy lokovleh demalka.

Vetana, mem la kalil begavvay at ochora, (begin) ella 40 petucha, 40 setuma. 40 petucha: dehu kad dechar itchabbar immah. 40 setuma: yovla. deha setimin archaha veaf al gav demitfashtin lezimnin, veit dematne vehay kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 4:12) gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, beshaata demalka kaddisha adkar lehu leyisrael begin shemeh, veahadrat matronita leatraha, (keden) ketiv, vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh. kach kahana, beshaata deal leyachada shema kaddisha, ulechappera bekudesha, lezavvevga lemalka bematronita. ketiv vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed vegomer.

Tana, ribbi yehuda amar, kahana ittear shelama bealma, leella vetatta. vetanya al bedarga chad, asche gufeh. nafik mehay darga, ledarga ochora asche gufeh. achid shelama behay uvehay, kiddesh yedoy, umitbarchan kachada. uvecholla bae leachazaa ovada, uvae leachazaa levushoy, deyitlabbash kegavvna deovada deyitkavvavn, ad disadder kolla kema deitzterich, veyitbarchun illae vetattae.
Tana ribbi shimon, patach (4) yod biglifoy, atvavn besitrin, itkashsheran beYod. yod azil leyod. (52) yod salik beYod. yod azil levav, mitkanneshe baAdonai. umechavvivn data, itchabbar Adonai beVav.

Adonai illaa achid taroy (sefer acher bateraavay) begillufe tachsisin, achada binhiru elef vachamesh mea veshivin achsadrin setimin. salik Adonai, veitattar chamshin zimnin, lan tarin kayymin dekayymin, kad itgelaf beitroy, naharin anpin demalka, vav itpeshat lev gelifin.

Meatter Adonai lev, (nusach acher mitatter beYod, Adonai 36) be elef vaAdonai mea kitrin, demitatteran bechad kitra, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) baatara, sheittera lo immo. 6 bitren reshin, resha deguleglata gelifa resha, kotza chad leella, vekotza chad letatta, vey nachit lev, (sefer acher vav nachit 43) gelifa degillufin begavvayyhu, shivin anpin deitrin meella letatta. beh tasin geviin ufarchin, da salik, veda nachit mitgallefin chad bechad.

Itkeshshar 10 baAdonai, Adonai bev, 6 baAdonai. (sefer acher 6 baAdonai, Adonai 8, 6 8, 6 baAdonai) da achid beda, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 49:24) vatteshev beetan kashto vayyafozzu zeroe yadav mide avir yaakov. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 24:21) etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha. keden itkeshshar
1166: Kolla chad bechad, da beda, naharin maftechan, venaharin anpin kullehu, keden kullehu naflin al anpayyhu, umizdazean, veamre berich shema yekara malchuteh lealam ulealme almin.
Kala mitkashshar immeh dechahana, vehu ativ legabbayyhu. veamar titharu. titharu la amrin shear kahane veamma, bar kahana rabba, kad itkeshshar beh hahu kala.
Tana, mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai, kevan dichtiv mikkol chattotechem, amay lifne Adonai. ella amar ribbi yitzchak, (Shemot 170 amud bet) lifne Adonai mammash.

Detanya, meresha deyarcha sifrin petichin, vedayyne dayyaynin. bechol yoma veyoma batte dinin itmasran, leittefatcha bedina, ad hahu yoma deikre tisha leyarcha. behahu yoma, sallekin dinin kullehu lemare dedina, umetakkene kuresyay illaa derachame, lemalka kaddisha. behahu yoma baan yisrael letatta, lemechde bechedvavta lekadmut marehon, dezammin leyoma ochora, lemetav alayyhu bechuresyay kaddisha derachame, bechuresyay devavtranuta.

Vechol innun sifrin diftichin kameh, uchetivin kameh kol innun chovin, hu mezakke lon, umadke lon mekullehu, hada hu dichtiv mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. lifne Adonai mammash, innun deamre kera, ad hacha amrin, vela yattir. velet reshu leochora delima titharu, ella kahana rabba, defalach pulechana, vekashar shema kaddisha befumeh, vechad hava itkeshar umitbarech befumeh, hahu kala nachit uvatash beh, veitnehir milla befumeh dechahana, veomer titharu. palach pulechana, umitbarchin kol innun illain deishtaaru.

Ulevatar asche gufeh, vekiddesh yedoy, leaala befulechana ochora kaddisha. ad deyitkavvavn lemeal laatar ochora illaa, kaddisha mikkolla. 3 shurin sacharin leh, kahane achoy, velevae, umikkol shear amma kullehu. (birchan kammeh) zakfin yedin aleh bitzlota vekitra dedahava zakfa beragleh. natil 3 pesian, vechullehu kayymin bekiyyumayyhu, vela natlin batreh (hava aktir ketoret).

Natil 3 pesian ochoran, (reshima belibba) aschar leducheteh. natil 3 pesian, astim ayynin, veitkeshar leella. al laatar deal, shama kol gadpe dichruvayyay mezammerin, veakishan gadpin perisan leella. hava aktir ketoret, mishtakkecha kol gadpayyhu uvilchishu itdabbekan.

I kahana zache, deha leella bechedu ishtechach, uf hacha behahi shaata nafik raava dinhora, mitbassema merechin deture afarsemona dachya dilella, veazla bechol hahu atar, ail recha bitre nukeve dechutameh, veityayshva libba. keden kolla hu bilchishu, ufitra la ishtechach tamman. patach kahana pumeh bitzlota biruta bechedvavta, vetzalle tzeloteh.

Batar desiyyem, zakfin keruveyay kemillekaddemin gadpayyhu, umezammerin. keden yada kahana diruta havo, veiddan chedvavta lecholla, veamma yadin deitkabbel tzeloteh, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 1:18) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu. vehu tav laachoreh, vetzalle tzeloteh. zakkaa chulakeh dechahana, deha al yedoy chedu al chedu ishtechach hahu yoma leella vetatta, al hahi shaata ketiv, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo, ashre haam sheAdonai elohav.

(Vayikra 16:29) vehayta lachem lechukkat olam bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh teannu et nafshotechem vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 26:9) nafshi ivviticha balayla af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka vegomer. nafshi ivviticha ballayla. nafshi ballayla mibbae leh, may nafshi ivviticha. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, yeshacharecha mibbae leh. ella hachi tana, kudesha berich hu rucha venafsha decholla, veyisrael amre nafshi veruchi annet. begin kach ivviticha leadbeka bach, vaashacharecha leashkecha reutach.
Ribbi yose amar, beshaata debar nash naim bearseh. nafka nafsheh, salka veashidat beh bebar nash, al kol ma daavad bechol yoma. gufa amar lenafsha, nafshi ivviticha ballayla,
1167: Davar acher nafshi ivviticha, amra keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, nafshi ivviticha ballayla, beod daana begaluta bene amamya, umenia nafshi mikkol bishata (nusach acher varevaynaa nafshi mikkol paysatea) dekutera bene amamya, nafshi ivviticha, begin leatava leatri. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, kelomar, af al gav deinnun meshabedin levanay, bechol shibuda, rucha kaddisha la itade minnay, begin lemishchar lach, ulemebad pikkudecha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, amru yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, beod denafshi bi, ivviticha ballayla. may taama ballayla, ella begin dehay nefesh behay shaata, itzterich lechamda lach. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, kad ittear bi rucha kaddisha, ashacharekka beitaruta lemebad reutach. ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz bezimna demishpat nachit beara, levasma alma, keden tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel. kelomar yachlin lemisbal dina detzedek, vela yishtetze alma minneh. ematay tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel, kaasher mishpatecha laaretz. rabbi chizkiyya amar, nafshi ivviticha ballayla, da keneset yisrael. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, da kudesha berich hu.

Ribbi abba hava yativ kameh deribbi shimon, kam ribbi shimon befalgu lelya, lemile beorayyta. kamu ribbi elazar veribbi abba immeh. patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim ken nafshi taarog elecha elohim. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, zakkain innun yisrael mikkol ammin, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta kaddisha, veorit lon nishmatin kaddishin meatar kaddisha, begin lemebad pikkudoy, uleishtaasha beorayyta, dechol man deishtaasha beorayyta, la dachil mikkolla. dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:92) lule toratcha shaashuay az avadti veanyi.

Man innun shaashuay. orayyta. deorayyta shaashuim ikre, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye shaashuim yom yom. veda hu detanenan, kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden. may leishtashea. begin lemechde behu. detanenan, zakkain innun tzaddikayya, dichtiv behu, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, begin leitannega mehahu shakyu denachala, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. kivyachol, kudesha berich hu mishtaasha behu, mehahu shakyu denachala, demitannege behu tzaddikayyay. veal da ate leishtashea im tzaddikayyay. vechol man deishtedal beorayyta, zache leishtashea im

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, behahu zimna, illen mare matnitin mare chachmeta illaa, mare kabbala, mare raze tora, shaata dechikat lon. vehay ihu deamar keayyal taarog al afike mayim, deinnun afike mayim deorayyta legabbe shechinta. velet tora, ella ammuda deemtztzaita. dihon illen afike mayim, betztzaara bigona beanyuta, veillen innun chavalim tzirin deyoleda, deihi shechinta, deittemar bah, (Mishlei 23:25-26) vetagel yoladtecha. uveinnun chavalim, tehe betztzaara dilhon.

Uveinnun chavalim detztzavvchat behon, ittearat shivin sanhedrin dilella, ad deyittear kol dilah ad Adonai, umiyyad (Tehillim 29:9) kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot, deinnun mare matnitin, (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reoteha, kullehon yihon lon chil kayyoleda mammash, bedachakin, dedachaka lon shaata, bechamma neshichin deyitztzer hara, dechivya denashich lon bechamma dachakin.

Behahu zimna itpattechat leolada meshicha, begin chavalim vedochakim detztzaddikim, umare middot, umare razin deorayyta, mare boshet vaanava, mare yira veahava, mare chesed, anshe chayil yire elohim, anshe emet, sone vatztza, dedachaka lon shaata. vehay hu deukemuha mare matnitin, dor shebben david ba, anshe chayil yesovvu meir lair vela yechonanu, veyire chet yimmaasu, vechachmat sofrim tisrach, uttehi haemet nederet, vehaggefen titten pirya, vehayyayin beyoker.
Umeinnun kalin deyahivat, deinnun shivin, lokovel shivin tevin
1168: Tana, keayyal taarog al afike mayim, da keneset yisrael. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 22:20) eyaluti leezrati chusha. taarog al afike mayim, vaday leishtakkeya mishshakyu demabbue denachala, al yede detzadik. taarog: kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6) laarugot habbosem, ken nafshi taarog elecha elohim. leishtakkeyay minach, bealma den uvealma deate.

Mabbue nachala man innun. mabbua chad leella, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan vegomer. umittamman nagid venafik, umashke ginta, vechol innun nachalin, nagdin venafkin umitkanneshin bitre mabbuin, deikrun netzach vehod, veillen ikrun afike mayim, behahu darga detzadik, demineh nagid venafik umishtakya ginta. begin kach ayyal utzevi kachada mishtachche, (nusach acher ayil utzevi ikrun ateret visod) tzedek vetzaddik.

Tana, ketiv (Tehillim 29:9) kol Adonai yecholel ayyalot, ayyalot, ayyelat ketiv chaser, da aylot hassade (nusach acher da ayyelet dashechar). (davar achar ayyalot hassade), detanya, befalgut lelya, beshaata dekudesha berich hu al leginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikayyay, hay kol nafik, vechaiv kol innun ayyalta desacharane kuresyay yakkira kaddisha, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) shishshim gibborim saviv lah. davar acher yecholel ayyalot, kema deat amer (Iyov 26:13) cholla yado nachash bariach. vayyechosof yearot kema deat amer. (Shmuel 1 12) beyarat haddevash, uchetiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yari im divshi, veyanka lehu keimma deyanka livnin.

Deyaancha Adonai beyom tzara, itpattechat rachmah, deihi 2, kelila mitteren betin, leolada 2 meshichin, veailat reshah ben birkaha, deihu resha dilah, ammuda deemtztzaita. teren shokaha, netztzach vehod, teren neviim. mittamman olidat teren meshichin. behahi zimna vayyechesof yearot, yitabbar nachash mealma (ad kan raya mehemana)

Amar leh ribbi abba, (Yeshayahu 26:9) nafshi ivviticha ballayla af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, nafshi ballayla mibbae leh. ashacharekka, yeshacharecha mibbae leh. amar leh ha ukemuha, (Bereshit 23) kema deat amer (Iyov 12:10) asher beyado nefesh kol chay veruach kol besar ish.

Ta chaze nafsha verucha ishtemoda (sefer acher ishtae) (sefer acher ashetatepay) kachada lealmin. tana pulechana shelemata devae bar nash lemiflach lekudesha berich hu, kema detanninan (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha vegomer. deyarchim leh lekudesha berich hu rechimuta denefesh mammash, veda hu rechimuta shelemata, rechimuta denafsheh verucheh. kema deitdebaku illen begufa, vegufa rachim lon. (sefer acher keden) kach yitdavak bar nash lerachama leh lekudesha berich hu, rechimuta denafsheh verucheh, leadbeka beh. hada hu dichtiv nafshi ivviticha ballayla (kelomar) nafshi mammash.

Af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, itdabbeka bach birchimuta sagia, ballayla. devae bar nash merchimuta dekudesha berich hu, lemekam bechol lelya, leishtadla befulechaneh, ad deyitar tzafra, veyitmeshach aleh chuta dechesed. detanya, zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash dirchimuta da rachim leh lekudesha berich hu, vehane zakkae keshot dimrachamin leh lekudesha berich hu hachi, alma mitkayyma beginehon, veshaltin al kol gezirin kashin dilella vetatta. (nusach acher hi) (begin deyitkayyem alma beginehon)

Tana, hahu zakkaa deitdavak berucheh venafsheh leella, bemalka kadisha, birchimuta kedka yeot. shallit beara diltatta, vechol ma degazar al alma itkayyaym. mena lan, meeliyyahu. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:1) chay Adonai asher amadti lefanav im yihye hashshanim haelle tal umatar ki im lefi devari.

Ta chaze, beshaata deatyayn nishmatin kadishin meella letatta, veinnun zakkae alma meshallefe lehu mimmalka umatronita, zeirin innun, divhahu shaata denachit, kayyeyma kame malka, ureuta demalka leistakkela bah, kema deokimna, beshaata denashav kudesha berich hu rucha bechol chela vechela dishmayya, kullehu chayyaylin itavidu, vekayyme bekiyyumayyhu, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 33:6) uveruach piv kol tzevaam. uminnayyhu itakkevu ad dekudesha berich hu
1169: Vetana, miyyoma deitbere alma, kayyme kammeh dekudesha berich hu, veitakkavu ad demata zimna leachata lon beara, veillen shelitu leella vetatta, hada hu dichtiv chay Adonai asher amadti lefanav, asher ani omed la ketiv, ella asher amadti. levatar ahdar leatreh, vesalik leiddareh, veinnun ochoranin la sallekin ad dimutun. begin dela kayymu kodem lachen keinnun ochoranin. uvegin kach eliyyahu itavid shelicha, malacha leella, veillen demitdabbekan yatir lemalka.

Ashkachna besifra deadam kadmaa dechol ruchin kadishin dilella, avdin shelichuta, vechullehu atyayn meatar chad. denishmathon detzadikayyay mittere dargin dichlilan bechad, uvegin kach sallekin yatir, vedargehon yatir, vehachi hu. vechol innun dahavo temirin tamman, nachtu useliku bechayyehon, kegon chanoch dela ishtechach beh mita. veha okimna milla da, bachanoch veeliyyahu.

Vetana mea veesrin vachamesh elef dargin (letzaddikayyay) lenishmathon detzaddikayyay, seliku biruta, ad la itbere alma, dekudesha berich hu mezammena lehu bealma den, bechol dara vedara, vesallekin vetasin alma, umitkashshere bitzrora dechayye, vezammin kudesha berich hu lechaddeta alma behu, alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:22) ki chaasher hashshamayim hachadashim vehaaretz hachadasha vegomer.

(Vayikra 16:29) teannu et nafshotechem, nafshotechem kaamar, begin deyisrael mishtachchin kame malka kadisha zakkain, vihe reuta dilhon legabbe kudesha berich hu, uleitdavka beh, begin deyitkapper lehu chovayyhu. veal da, man deachal veshate bitshiaa, umeannega nafsheh bemechla umishteyay, ishtechach baasiraa innuya denafsha bitren chulakin, veishtechach keillu itanne teshiaa vaasiraa. et nafshotechem: leachlela kolla, gufa venafsha, uleitkannea behay yoma, leitkappera al chovehon.
Tana ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem. bayom hazze. hayyom hazze mibbae leh. ella bayom hazze dayyka, deveh itgele attika kaddisha, lechappara al chovehon decholla.

Davar acher teannu et nafshotechem. ribbi abba patach veamar, (Kohelet 9:14) ir ketanna vaanashim bah meat vegomer, ir ketanna, ha ukemuha. aval ir ketanna, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 26:1) ir az lanu yeshua yashit chomot vachel vegomer. uchetiv (Hoshea 11:9) velo avo beir. ir ketanna, zeera hi, dehi batraa mikkolla, tattaa micholla, shuroy ravrevin, takkifin, kaddishin, ir hakkodesh ikre. vaanashim bah meat, zeirin innun dezakkan lesalleka legavvav, ulemishre bah, kema deat amer (Tehillim 24:3) mi yaale vehar Adonai umi yakum bimkom kadsho vegomer. veal da anashim bah meat.

Uva eleha melech gadol, da kudesha berich hu. leizdavvevga bah, ulemishre bah, vesavav otah, kema deat amer (Zecharya 2:9) vaani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv vegomer. uvana aleha metzodim gedolim, devana shuroy, ravrevin takkifin yeeyan veshappirin (sefer acher mikkol avnin yakkirin) kaddishin. ir hakkodesh ikre, vechol yekara demalka ayyil begavvav. uvegin kach, hi bilchodaha kelila mikkol itre demalka, vechol itre malka bah mitatterin. begin kach, vaanashim bah meat ketiv.

Umatza vah ish misken vechacham, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 15) neki chappayim uvar levav. misken: kema deat amer (Shemot 1:11) vayyiven are miskenot lefaro, mitattar beitrin takkifin, beitre orayyta, beitre pikkude orayyta demalka. vechacham, dezache bah behay chachma. vechacham, dehu chakkim yatir mikkolla leayyeyna befulechana demareh, begin lemizke bah, uleaala bah. hada hu dichtiv, umillat hu et hair bechachmato. umillat: kemo (Shmuel 1 20:29) immalta na veere et echay, (Bereshit 19:20) immalta na shamma. uf hacha umillat hu et hair bechachmato.
Veadam lo zachar et haish hammisken hahu, veadam la zachar, lemebad pikkude orayyta, leishtaddela beorayyta, kehahu gevar miskena deitchabbar becholla,
1170: Begin lemizke bah. (Kohelet 9:16) veamarti ani tova chachma miggevura. deha behahu alma, la yahavin reshu lemeal, bar hane zakkae keshot, hane demishtaddele bah beorayyta yoma velele, umitattere befikkude orayyta behay alma, lemeal behu lealma deate.

Vechachmat hammisken bezuya udevarav enam nishmaim. deha bene nasha la mistakkelin beh, vela baan leitchabbera beh, uleatzit lemilloy. detana, kol man deatzit lemilloy deorayyta, zakkaa hu behay alma, ucheillu kabbil tora missinay. vaafillu mikkol bar nash name bae lemishma milloy deorayyta. uman dearchin udeneh lokovleh, yahiv yekara lemalka kaddisha, veyahiv yekara leorayyta. aleh ketiv, (Devarim 27:9) hayyom hazze nihyeta leam laAdonai elohecha.

Tana, yoma chad havo azle chavrayyay immeh deribbi shimon, amar rabbi shimon, chamena illen ammin kullehu illae, veyisrael tattae mikkullehu, may taama. begin demalka ashdar matronita minne, veail ammahu beatraha (kelomar shifcha). kema deat amer, (Mishlei 30:23) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegomer. tachat eved ki yimloch vegomer. veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. man shifcha. hi kitra nucheraa, dekatal kudesha berich hu buchera dilhon bemitzrayim. dichtiv (Shemot 11:5) ad bechor hashshifcha asher achar harechayim. achar harechayim havat yatva bekadmita, vehasheta, hay shifcha tirash gevirtah.

Bacha rabbi shimon veamar, malka bela matronita, la ikre malka. malka deitdavak beshifcha beammahu dematronita, an hu yekara dileh. uzemina kala levassera lematronita, velema (Zecharya 9:9) gili meod bat tziyyon harii bat yerushala 40 hinne malkech yavo lach tzaddik venosha hu. kelomar, tzaddik hu nosha, begin dehava rachiv ad hasheta baatar delav dileh, baatar nucheraa, veyanik leh.

Veal da ketiv ani verochev al chamor, ani (dela) hava bekadmita, verochev al chamor, kema deokimna, innun kitrin tattain deammin ovde avoda zara, dekatil kudesha berich hu buchera dilhon bemitzrayim, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 11:5) vekol bechor behema, veha okimna mille. kivyachol tzadik venosha hu, hu vadday yattir mikkolla. begin dead hasheta share tzaddik bela tzedek. vehasheta deyizdavvevgun kachada, tzadik venosha hu, deha la yativ besitra ochora. tana, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzadik avad veen ish sam al lev vegomer, hay kera kashya, hatztzadik avad, neevad mibbae leh, mahu avad. ella avad mammash, umay avad. avad lematronita, veitdavak baatar ochora, deikre shifcha.

Amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi shimon, i nicha kame demor, ha detanenan, dichtiv (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam, man deamar, deal shiva kayymin kayyeyma alma. uman deamar, al chad kayyeyma alma, hech mityayshshevan mille. amar leh, kolla milla chad hu, deha 7 innun uvehu it chad kayyeyma, deikre tzaddik, vekayyme aleh, vealma behay itkayyeyma. vechad itkayyeyma alma aleh, keillu itkayyaym al kullehu shiva. veal da ketiv, vetzaddik yesod olam. veha okimna mille bechamma atar.

Vetana, hay shifcha zemina leshalletaa beara kaddisha diltatta, kema dahavat matronita shalta bekadmita, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 1:21) tzedek yalin bah, vehasheta shifcha ki tirash gevirtah becholla. vezammin kudesha berich hu, leatava lematronita leatraha kekadmeta, ucheden mimman hu chedvavta, havi ema chedvavta demalka, vechedvavta dematronita. chedvavta demalka, begin deyetuv lah veyitperash mishshifcha, kadka amena. vechedvavta dematronita, begin detetuv leizdavvevga bemalka, hada hu dichtiv gili meod bat tziyyon vegomer.

Ta chaze, ketiv vehayta zot lachem lechukkat olam. vehayta lachem mibbae leh, may zot. ha deamaran, lechukkat olam. bechol atar vaatar chukkat olam itkere, gezera demalka, deayyil kol nimusoy baatar da, veastim lon, keman desatim kolla, beaskufa chada. (180) chukkat olam vaday. behay zot
1171: Rashim vechakak kol genizin dileh, vechol temirin dileh.

(Vayikra 16:29) bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh. beasor dayyka, kema deokimna. teannu et nafshotechem, vadday hachi hu, veha ittemar nafshotechem vadday. deha benafsha talya milleta, uvegin kach, achila ushetiyya mitteshiaa, yatir miyyoma ochora. veaf al gav dehay milla ittemar begavvna ochora, vecholla shappir, vehay vehay milla chada, vechol chad beatreh, vehachi hu.

Vetana, behay yoma, kol chedu, vechol nehiru, vechol vavtranuta dealmin, kullehu talyayn beimma illaa, dechol mabbuin nagdin venafkin minnah. ucheden nehirin kol innun butzinin, venaharin vinhiru bechedvavta, ad demitbesam kolla. ucheden kol innun dinin ishtechachu binhiru, vedina la itavid, veal da teannu et nafshotechem.

Amar ribbi abba, ha okim lah mor, min gufa dematnita, la galu yisrael meartzam, ad shekkafru bekudesha berich hu. dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 20:1) en lanu chelek bedavid velo nachala beven yishay, veha ittemar. kera acharina ashkachna behay, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 12:16) ree vetcha david. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, bet david ikre, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:Adonai) bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai. bet yaakov, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 60:7) uvet tifarti afaer. lechu venelcha beor Adonai, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan, venata hay gan leishtashea beh im tzaddikayyay, deveh sharyayn.

Tana, ketiv ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu vegomer veinnitem et nafshotechem. uchetiv vehayta lachem lechukkat olam bachodesh hashshevii vegomer. ach dichtiv, may ka bae hacha. amar leh, lemiuta ka atya. dechevan deamar veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh, amar levatar ach beasor. ach asor mibbae leh, deveasor talya milleta.

Amar leh i hachi, (Shemot 12:15) ach bayom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem, vetanenan ach chillek, chetzyo asur baachilat chametz, vechetzyo muttar. uf hacha ach beasor lachodesh, ema dechetzyo asur bammelacha (nusach acher baachila), vechetzyo muttar. amar leh uf hacha bivinnitem et nafshotechem talya, deha innuy la ishtechach ella mippalgut yoma ulehala, veshappir hu ach chillek bivinnitem et nafshotechem.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv, (Vayikra 16:30) ki bayom haze yechapper alechem vegomer. achapper alechem mibbae leh. ella yechapper alechem, leachlela yovla, denagid mabbue leashkaa behay yoma lechol ivar, learvaa kolla, uleashkaa kolla. veda alechem, kelomar, beginechon ledakkea lechon behay yoma, dichtiv lifne Adonai titharu. vela yishlot alayychu dina.

Ribbi yehuda, amar zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, uvae ledakkea lehu, dela yishtekach behu chova, begin dihon bene hechaleh, vidurun behechaleh. ulezimna deate ketiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 130:1) shir hammaalot mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. tanenan, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu alma, baa lemivre bar nash, amlich beorayyta, amra kammeh, tive lemivre hay bar nash, zammin hu lemechete kammach, zammin hu leargaza kammach. i taavid leh keovadoy, ha alma la yachil lemekam kammach, kol shekken hahu bar nash. amar leh, vechi lemaggana itkarina, (Shemot 34:6) el rachum vechannun erech appayim.

Vead la bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara teshuva, amar lah litshuva, ana baena lemivre bar nash bealma, al menat dechad yetuvun lach mechovehon, detehevi zemina lemishbak chovehon, ulechappera alayyhu. uvechol shaata veshaata teshuva zemina legabbe bene nasha, vechad bene nasha tayyvin mechovayyhu, hay teshuva tavat legabbe kudesha berich hu, vechipper al kolla, vedinin itkafyayn, umitbasseman kullehu, uvar nash itdache mechoveh.
Ematay itdache bar nash mechoveh beshaata deal behay teshuva kadka chaze. ribbi yitzchak amar, detav kame malka illaa, vetzalle
1172: Tzelota meumeka delibba, hada hu dichtiv mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai.

Ribbi abba amar, mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai, atar ganiz hu leella, vehu amika (Shemot 63 amud bet) devera, umehay nafkin nachalin umabbuin lechol ivar, vehahu amika daamikta ikre teshuva. uman devae leatava uleitdakkea mechovoy, behay umeka itzterich lemikre lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai.

Tana, beshaata dehava bar nash chav kame mareh, vekariv karbaneh al madbecha, vechahana mechapper aleh, uvae bauteh aleh, mitarin rachame, vedinin mitbasseman, uteshuva arik birchan, bemabbuin denagdin venafkin, umitbarchin kullehu butzinin kachada, uvar nash itdache mechoveh.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu, appik eser kitrin, itrin kaddishin leella, deitattar behu, umitlabbash behu, vehu innun, veinnun hu, keshalhova daachida begumera, velet tamman piruda. lokovel dena, it eser kitrin dela kaddishin letatta, veinnun achidan bezuhama detufera dechad itra kaddisha, deikre chachma. veal da ikrun chachmot.

Vetana, asra zine chachmot illen nachtu lealma. vechullehu isteavu (sefer acher ashetaabav) bemitzrayim, bar mechad deitpeshat bealma, vechullehu zine charshe innun, uminnayyhu yade mitzrayim charshin, al kol bene alma. vechad mitzrae baan lemebad kenufeyay becharshayyhu leovadehon, havo nafke lechakla leture ramae, vedavchin devachin, veavdin gummin beara, vesacharin hahu dama socharaneh dehane gummin, ushear dama mitkannefe behanehu gummin, uvisra shavin alayyhu. ukarvin karbenehon, leinnun zinin bishin, veinnun zinin bishin mitkanneshin umitkarvin kachada, umitpayyeysin bahadayyhu behahu tura.

Yisrael dahavo beshibudehon, havo mitkarvin lehon, veolfu minnayyhu, vahavu taan batrayyhu, vehayeynu dichtiv kemaase eretz mitzrayim asher yeshavtem bah lo taasu uchemaase eretz kenaan vegomer, uchetiv velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim vegomer. tana, beshaata dahavo mekarvin lehon al gabbe chakla, vahavu mezammene hahu dama, umekarve karbenayyhu, havo mitkannefe kol innun zinin bishin, vechaman lehon kegavvna disirim, kullehu malyayn saara, umodae lehu ma deinnun bayayn.

Ta chaze, yitzchak ma ketiv beh, (Bereshit 27:22) vayyiggash yaakov el yitzchak aviv vaymushshehu, amar, da la itade (sefer acher hacha lo ittear), ella mittalla dishmayya denagid al ara. amar ribbi yose, umishmanne haaretz, becholla beracheh. may tama. begin dechama leh besara, amar lemebar da, umishmanne haaretz itzterich, vela zuhama deara, dehay zuhama hu deara, vechad talla dishmayya umigda deara mitchabberan itabbar hay zuhama.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, batrayyta deinnun kitrin tattain dela kaddishin hay hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 18:11) vedoresh el hammetim, veda hu ashiraa decholla. detanya amar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehuda, nafshata derashiayyay illen innun mazzikin dealma.

Amar ribbi yose, i hachi tav lehu lechayyayvayya deitabbedin mazzikin bealma, an hu onsha degehinnam. an hu bisha dizmina lehu behahu alma. amar ribbi chiyyay, hachi tanenan, veha okimna mille, nafshata derashiayyay beshaata denafkin mealma, kama gardine nimusin mizdammene lekabbela lehu, ulealaa lehu legehinam, vealin lehu bitlat dinin bechol yoma, bagehinnam. levatar mizdavvevge behu, veazlin veshatin bealma, umatan lehu lerashiayyay, leinnun deka astim teshuva mikkammayyhu. levatar tayyvin lehu legehinam, veitsavin (nusach acher vaatadenaven) tamman, vechach bechol yoma.

Levatar deazlin behu, veshatin behu bealma, mehadderin lekivrayyhu, vechamman tolata degufa menakkere bisra umitabbelan alayyhu, veinnun charshin havo azle leve kivre, vecharshe becharshayyhu, veavdin chad tzalma devar nash, vedavchin kammeh chad tzefira. levatar alin lehahu
1173: Tzefira, behahu kivra, vehahu tzalma metabberin (sefer acher madberin) leh learba sitrin, umaalin leh learba zivvyayn dekivra. keden mecharshe becharshayyhu, umitkannefe innun kinnufe, veinnun zinin bishin, umayytin hahi nafshata, veal bekivra umishtae bahadayyhu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkain innun tzaddikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate, deha kullehu kaddishin. gufa dilhon kaddisha. nafsha dilhon kaddisha. rucha dilhon kaddisha. nishmeta dilhon kodesh kodashim. telat dargin innun, kegavvna dilella. detanya amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya, da hi nishmeta (illaa) deadam kadmaa (illaa). ta chaze, telat dargin innun, veitdevaku kechad, nefesh, ruach, neshama. veillaa minnayyhu, neshama.

Deamar ribbi yose, bechullehu bene nasha it nefesh, veit nefesh illaa minnefesh. zacha bar nash behay nefesh, merikin aleh itra chad, deikre ruach. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 32:15) ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom. keden ittear bar nash beitaruta ochora illaa, leistakkela benimuse malka kaddisha. zacha bar nash beh behahu rucha, meatterin leh bechitra kaddisha illaa, dechalil kolla, deikre neshama. deitkere nishmat eloah.

Vetana beraza derazin, bego razin desifra dishlomo malka. hay kera, dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, kevan dichtiv veshabbeach ani et hammetim, amay shekvar metu. ella shekvar metu behay alma, befulechana demarehon. (Bereshit 224 amud bet)

Vetamman ketiv, telat madorin avad kudesha berich hu letzaddikayyay, chad (sefer acher dezachu inun tzaddikayyay dela ayshatetzayav mehay alma vechad itzterich) lenafshan deinnun tzaddikayyay, dela istelaku mehay alma, ushechichin behay alma. vechad itzterich alma rachamin, veinnun chayyin yatvin betzaara, innun metzalu tzelota alayyhu, veazlin umodin milla leinnun demichin dechevron, umitarin, vealin legan eden deara, detamman ruchehon detzaddikayyay, mitlabbeshan beitrin dinhora, veityayatu behu, vegazrin gezera, vekudesha berich hu avid reuta dilhon, vechas al alma.

Veinnun nafshan detzaddikayyay, mishtakkechin behay alma, leaggana al chayyaya, vehay ikre nefesh, veda la istalka (sefer acher ishtetze) mehay alma, ushechicha behay alma, leistakkela uleminda uleaggana al dara. vehay hu deamru chavrayyay, demete yade betzaara dealma. veonsha dechayyayvin di beara, behay hu, dichtiv venichreta hannefesh hahi meammeha.

Umadora tinyayna hu gan eden di beara. beh aved kudesha berich hu madorin illain yakkirin, kegavvna dehay alma, uchegavvna dealma illaa. vehechalin bitren gavvnin, delet lehon chushebana, veilanin vaasavin verechin desallekin bechol yoma. uvehay atar share hahu deikre ruach deinnun tzaddikayyay, umadora dehahu rucha beh share. vechol ruach veruach mitlabbesha bilvush yakkira, kegavvna dehay alma, uchegavvna dehahu alma illaa.

Madora telitaa, hahu madora illaa kaddisha deitkere tzerora dechayye. detamman mitaddena hahu darga illaa kaddisha, deikre neshama. vehay itdevak leitannega beidduna illaa. aleh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha vegomer.

Vetana, beshaata deitzterich alma rachame, veinnun tzaddikayyay zakkain. hahu nefesh deishtakkecha bealma, leaggana al alma. nefesh salik veazil veshat bealma, umoda leruach. veruach salik veitattar, umoda lanshama. uneshama lekudesha berich hu. ucheden chas kudesha berich hu al alma. keden nachta meella letatta, neshama oda leruach, veruach oda lenafsha.

Uvechol shabbeta veshabbeta, veresh yarcha, kullehu, mitchabberan umitatteran kechad, ad deizdevvavgu lemete lesaggeda lemalka illaa. ulevatar tayyvin leatrayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato yavo chol basar vegomer.

Uveshaata deitzterich alma rachame, vechayaya azle umodae lehu lenafshayyhu detzaddikayyay, uvachan al kivrayyhu, innun deitchazo leodaa lehu. may tama. deshavyayn reuta dilhon leitdabbeka nafsha benafsha,
1174: Keden ittearin nafshayyhu detzaddikayyay, umitkannefe veazlin veshatin lidmiche chevron, umodie lehu tzaara dealma. vechullehu alin behahu pitcha degan eden, umodie leruach. veinnun ruchin demitatteran began eden, malache illain azle benayyhu. vechullehu modiin lanshama. uneshama odaat lekudesha berich hu, vechullehu baan rachame al chayyin, vechas kudesha berich hu al alma beginehon. veal da amar shelomo, veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu vegomer.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, tavvavhna i it man deyada leodaa lehu lemetayyay, bar anan. amar ribbi abba, tzaara moda lehu. orayyta moda lehu. deha beshaata delet man deyada behay, (Bereshit 221 amud alef) afke orayyta samuch lekivri, veinnun mitare, al orayyta al ma itgalyay lehahu atar, keden duma oda lehon.

Amar ribbi yose, veinnun yade deha alma betzaara, vechayaya la itchazun, vela yade leodaa lehu. beh shaata kullehu tzavvchin al orayyta deitkelana veitgalyay lehahu atar. i bene nasha tayyvin uvachan belibba shelim, vetayyvin kame kudesha berich hu, kullehu mitkanneshe, uvaan rachame, umodiin leinnun demiche chevron, vealin umodin leruach dobbegan eden, kema deamaran.

Vei innun la tayyvin belibba shelim lemibbae ulemivke al tzaara dealma. vavy lehon, dechullehu mitkannefe lereka amre man garam leorayyta kaddisha deitgalyay al yedayyhu bela teshuva. vechullehu atan leitchadta (sefer acher leadkera) chovayyhu begine kach la yahachun tamman bela teshuva uvela taanita lemibbae bauta kammayyhu. ribbi abba amar, (sefer acher kolla attelat) bela telat taanita. ribbi yose amar, afillu chad, uvehahu yoma, uvilvad dealma yativ betzaara tefe, keden kullehu mizdavvevge lemibbae rachamin al alma.

Tana, amar ribbi yehuda, yoma chad havo azle (144 amud alef, 91) ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa beorcha, aru begush chalav, vahava chariv, yatvu samich leve kivre, veribbi yesa hava bideh chad chutera (sefer acher kaytarea) desefer tora deikra, ad deyatvu itregish chad kivra kamayyhu, vetzavavch vavy vavy, deha alma betzaara shechiach, ha orayyta hacha deitgalyay, o chayyaya atu lechayyeycha alan, ulechassefa bechissufa alan beorayytayyhu. izdaazau ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya man at. amar leh meta ana, veha ittearna legabbe sefer tora. dezimna chada hava yativ alma betzaara, veatu chayyaya hacha, leitteara lan besefer tora, vaana vechavray akdimna legabbe demiche chevron, vechad itchabbaru began eden beruchehon detzaddikayyay, ishtechach kamayyhu, dehahu sefer tora deayytu lekamman innun chayaya, hava pasul umeshakker bishma demalka, al deishtechach vav yattir behahu kera (Vayikra 11) divshosaat shesa shete ferasot, veamru dehoil veshakkeru bishma demalka dela yetuvun legabbehon, vedachu li ulechavray behahi shaata mibbe metivta.

Ad dechad sava dehava benayyhu, azal veayyte safra derav hamenuna sava, ucheden ittear (Kohelet Rabba pasuk shalach lachmecha) ribbi elazar berabbi shimon, dehava kavir immana, veazal uvaa began eden alayyhu, veitse alma, keden sharu lan, umin hahu yoma disliku leh leribbi elazar mibbe kivra da, veityeyhiv legabbe avuha, let man deittear lemekam kammayyhu didmiche chevron, demistappena min hahu yoma dedachu li velachaveray. vehasheta atittun legabban, vesefer tora gabbechon, amena deha alma betzaara ishtechach. veal da izdaazaana, daamena man yakdim leodaa leinnun zakkae keshot demiche chevron, ishtemit ribbi yesa behahu kitra desefer tora. amar ribbi chizkiyya, chas veshalom let alma betzaara, vaanan la atenan lehay.

Kamu ribbi chizkiyya veribbi yesa veazlu. amre, vadday beshaata dezakkain la ishtechachu bealma, alma la mitkayyeyma ella beginehon demetayyay. amar ribbi yesa, beshaata deitzterich alma lemitra, amay azlenan legabbehon demetayyay, veha ketiv
1175: (Devarim 18:11) vedoresh el hammetim veasir. amar leh ad kan la chameta gadpa detzippara deeden. vedoresh el hammetim, el hammetim dayyka. deinnun chayyayve alma, deinnun meammin ovde avoda zara, deishtechachu tadir metim. aval yisrael deinnun zakkae keshot, shelomo kera alayyhu (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu, bezimna ochora vela hasheta. shekkevar metu, vehasheta innun chayyin.

Veod, dishar ammin kad atan limtehon, atyayn becharshin, leitteara alayyhu zinin bishin. vechad yisrael atan limtehon, atyayn bechamma teshuva lekamme kudesha berich hu. bitviru delibba, betaanita lokovleh, vecholla begin denishmatin kaddishin yivun rachame lekamme kudesha berich hu alayyhu, vekudesha berich hu chayis al alma beginehon.

Veal da tanenan, tzaddika af al gav deitpetar mehay alma, la istallak vela itavid mekullehu almin, deha bechullehu almin ishtechach yattir mechayyyoy. divchayyyoy ishtechach behay alma bilchodoy, ulevatar ishtechach bitlat almin, vezammin legabbayyhu, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:3) alamot ahevucha, al tikre alamot, ella olamot. zakkaa chulakehon.

Tana, ketiv (Shmuel 1 25:29) vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim, vehayta nefesh adoni, nishmat adoni mibbae leh. ella kema deamaran, dezakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay decholla itkeshar da beda, nefesh beruach, veruach binneshama, uneshama bekudesha berich hu. ishtechach denefesh tzerura bitzror hachayyim.

Amar ribbi elazar, hay deamru chavrayyay, galuta desefer tora afillu mibbe kenishta leve kenishta ochora asir. vekol shekken leve rechov, amay leve rechov. amar ribbi yehuda, kema deamaran, begin deyitarun aleh veyitbeun rachame al alma. amar ribbi abba, shechinta kad itgalyay hachi name meatar laatar, ad deamra (Yirmeyahu 9:1) mi yitteneni vammidbar melon orchim vegomer uf hacha bekadmita mibbe kenishta leve kenishta, levatar leve rechov, levatar bammidbar melon orchim. amar ribbi yehuda, bene bavel mistafu vela ka avre afillu mibbe kenishta leve kenishta, kol shekken hay.

Tanya, amar lehu rabbi shimon lechavrayya, beyomay la yitztarchun bene alma lehay. amar leh ribbi yose, tzaddikayyay meginnin al alma bechayyehon, uvemitathon yoter mechayyehon. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 37:35) vegannoti al hair hazot lehoshiah lemaani ulemaan david avdi, veillu bechayyyohi la ketiv. amar ribbi yehuda may shena hacha dichtiv lemaani ulemaan david avdi, deshakil hay legabbe hay. ella, begin dedavid zacha leitkashshera birticha kaddisha daavahata, uvegin kach kolla chad, berich hu lealam ulealme almayya.

(Vayikra 18:3) kemaase eretz mitzrayim asher yeshavtem bah lo taasu, ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 102:22) lesapper betziyyon shem Adonai utehillato biyrushala 40. tamman tanenan, shema kaddisha satim vegalya. veorayyta dehi shema kaddisha illaa, satim vegalya. vechol kera divorayyta, vechol parsheta deorayyta, satim vegalya.

Detanya amar ribbi yehuda, mechatzifuta detzaddeket chada, nafkan kema tavan lealma. uman hi. tamar. dichtiv, (Bereshit 38:14) vatteshev befetach enayim. amar ribbi abba, parsheta da mochach, deorayyta satim vegalya. veha istakkalna beorayyta kulla, vela ashkachna atar deikre petach enayim, ella kolla satim, veraza derazin hu.

Vetanya, may chamat tzaddeket zo leovada da. ella yadat beveta dachamohi archoy dekudesha berich hu, hech madber hay alma im bene nasha. uvegin dehi yadat, kudesha berich hu okim milla al yedaha. veazla ha kema detanenan, izdammenat havat bat sheva 46 yeme bereshit lemehevi immeh dishlama malka. uf hacha izdammenat havat tamar leda, miyyoma deitbere alma.

Vatteshev befetach enayim, man petach enayim kema deat amer, (Bereshit 18:1) vehu yoshev petach haohel. uchetiv, (Shemot 12:23) ufasach Adonai al happetach. uchetiv (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek vegomer. enayim: dechol ayynin dealma
1176: Lehay pitcha metzappan. asher al derech timnata, may timnata. kema deat amer (Bamidbar 12) utemunat Adonai yabbit. vehachi okimna, tamar okimat milla letatta, ufarchat parchin, vaanitzat anfin beraza dimhemnuta.

(Hoshea 12:1) vihuda od rad im el veim kedoshim neeman. vayireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona vegomer. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 30:20) ken derech ishsha menaafet. ki chisseta paneha, veokimna ki chisseta paneha, kema deat amer, achla umachata fiha, okidat alma beshalhovoy, veamra lo faalti avn. may tama. begin ki chisseta paneha, velet man deyeda orchaha, leishtezava minnah. vayyet eleha el hadderech, el hadderech mammash, leitchabbera chivvavra besumaka. vayomer hava na avo elayich vegomer, ha okimna hava bechol atar.

Ki lo yada ki challato hi. ki challato hi dealma, metargeminan ari shetzayyta dealma hi. may taama la yada. begin deha menaharan anpaha, lekabbela minneh, veizdammena leitbassema ulerachama alma (davar achar) ki challato hi, da kalla mammash, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla.

Vattomer ma titten li ki tavo elay. hasheta kalla baya tachshitaha. vayomer anochi ashallach gedi izzim min hatztzon. lemalka dehava leh bera meamahu chada, veazil behechala, baa malka leitnasseva bematronita illaa, ulealaa behechaleh. amra man yahiv leh behechaleh demalka (nusach acher man yahiv leh ledin behechaleh demalka. amar malka), amar mikkan ulehala ashdar veattarich livra deamahu mehechala dili.

Kach name hacha, anochi ashallach gedi izzim min hatztzon. veha okimna, belo tevashshel gedi. vechol innun besitra divchor behema ka atu. veal da la ketiv anochi etten, ella anochi ashallach, attarich veashdar leh, dela yishtekach behechali.

Vattomer im titten eravon ad shalchecha. illen innun simanin dematronita, deitbarcha min malka beziuugaha. vayyomer ma haeravon asher etten lach, vattomer chotamcha ufetilecha umattecha. illen innun (nusach acher sitre) kitre illae, tachshitaha dechalla itbarcha mittelata illen, netzach hod yesod, vecholla ishtechach bitlata illen vechala (sefer acher manetzach hod yesod) mehacha mitbarcha. miyyad vayyitten lah vayyavo eleha vattahar lo. vayyehi kemishlosh chodashim. man mishlosh chodashim. batar ditalletun yarchayya, veha 3 yarchin okimna. vehacha kemishlosh chodashim, deshari yarcha reviaa leitteara dinin bealma bechove bene nasha, vehi yanka missitra ochora. keden, vayyuggad lihuda lemor zanta tamar kallatecha, ha kalla besitra ochora ishtechachat. ma ketiv, hotziuha. kema dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz tiferet yisrael. vetissaref, beshalhove tihara begaluta. ma ketiv, hi mutzet, leitmashshecha begaluta. vehi shalcha el chamiha lemor leish asher elle lo. leish asher elle mimmenu la ketiv, ella leish asher elle lo. dileh simanin illen mishtakkechin, anochi hara. miyyad vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni. tzadka vadday, ushema garim. man garim lah, shema da. hadar veamar mimmenni, dichtiv, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev yashar yechozu fanemo. tzadka: tzadak Adonai, demimmenni natlat shema da. mimmenni yarta. mimmenni ishtechachat.
Amar ribbi yose, may tama chamiha ketiv baatar chad, yehuda baatar ochora. amar leh, kolla itketar da beda. chamiha, baatar illaa tale.

Amar ribbi elazar, parsheta da okimna beraza illaa, bechamma gavvnin. kad yistakkelun mille, minnah yishtema razin deorchoy dekudesha berich hu, vedinoy bechol atar. vehi yadat veakdimat garmaa lemilla da, leashlema orchoy dekudesha berich hu, begin deyinpeku minnah malchin shallitin, uzeminin leshalletaa al alma. verut kehay gavvna avdat.

Amar ribbi abba, parsheta da beraza dechachmeta deorayyta itkashshera, vecholla satim vegalya. veorayyta kolla kehay gavvna ishtechachat. velet lacha milla beorayyta, dela rashim bah shema kaddisha illaa, desatim vegalya.
1177: Begine kach, setime deorayyta, kaddishe elyonin yartin lah, veitgalya bishar bene alma. kegavvna da ketiv, (Tehillim 102:22) lesapper betziyyon shem Adonai utehillato biyrushala 40, deha betziyyon bemakdesha, share leadkera shema kaddisha kadka chaze. ulevar bechinnuyo. veal da kolla satim vegalya. tana, kol man degara at chad meorayyta. o yosif at chad beorayyta, keman dimshakker bishma kaddisha illaa demalka.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ovada demitzrayim palchin leshifcha, kema deokimna. ovada dichnaan, palchin lehahu deikre (Shemot 12:29) shevi asher bevet habbor. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 9:25) arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. begin kach kullehu machtivin (sefer acher mevarchin) (sefer acher makedabeyn) bemillin kaddishin, veavdin ovadin (sefer acher eryayn) becholla. begine kach kemaase eretz mitzrayim asher yeshavtem bah vegomer. ribbi yehuda amar, deavdin dinin (sefer acher zinin) bishin leshalta al (nusach acher lesaava) ara, kema deat amer velo tetamme et admatcha. uchetiv vattitma haaretz.

(Vayikra 18:3) kemaase eretz mitzrayim vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach, (Iyov 38:13) leechoz bechanfot haaretz vegomer, tana, zammin kudesha berich hu ledakkea leareh, mikkol mesaavuta deammin ovde avoda zara, desaivu lah. kehay man deachid betaliteh, veanar tinnufa minneh. vechol innun deitkevaru beara kaddisha, lemishde lon levar, uledakkea ara kaddisha missitra ochora (sefer acher kaddisha achara), kivyachol dehava mattezana lishar ravreve ammin, ulekabbela mesaavuta dilhon, uledabbera lon. vezammin ledakkea lah uleabera lon levar.

Ribbi shimon hava madke ture (sefer acher shevake) ditverya, vechol dehava tamman mit, hava salik leh, umedakke ara. tana, ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:7) vattavou vattetammeu et artzi vegomer, amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulakeh man dezache bechayyyoy lemishre madora beara kaddisha. dechol man dezache lah, zache leangeda mittalla dishmayya dilella, denachit al ara. vechol man dezache leitkashshera bechayyyoy behay ara kaddisha, zache leitkashshera levatar beara kaddisha illaa.

Vechol man dela zache bechayyoy, umayytin leh leitkabbera tamman, aleh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:7) venachalati samtem letoeva. rucheh nafik birshuta nucheraa ochora, vegufeh ate techot reshuta deara kaddisha, kivyachol avid kodesh chol, vechol kodesh. vechol man dezache lemeppak nishmateh beara kaddisha, itkeparu chovoy, vezache leitkashshera techot gadpoy dishchinta, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:43) vechipper admato ammo. velo od ella i zache bechayyyoy, zache leitmashshecha aleh rucha kaddisha tadir, vechol man deyativ birshuta ochora, itmeshach aleh rucha ochora nucheraa.

Tana, kad salik rav hamenuna sava lehatam, havo immeh teresar bene metivta dileh, amar lon, i ana azil learcha da, lav al didi ka avidna, ella leatava pikdona lemareh. tanenan kol innun dela zachu lehay bechayyyoy, ativin pikdona demarehon leochora.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, begine kach, kol man deabar meinnun zinin bishin, o reshuta ochora beara, ara isteavat, vavy leh lehahu gevar, vavy lenafsheh, deha ara kaddisha la mekabbela leh levatar. aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 104:35) yittammu chattaim min haaretz, baolam hazze, uvaolam habba, ureshaim od enam, bitchiyyayt hammetim, keden barachi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah.

(Vayikra 18:4) et mishpatay taasu veet chukkotay tishmeru lalechet bahem vegomer, ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulaka deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu mikkol ammin ovde avoda zara, uvegin rechimuta dileh alayyhu, yahiv lon nimusin dikshot, nata behu ilana dechayye, ashre shechinta benayyhu. may tama. begin deyisrael reshimin birshima kaddisha bivsarehon. veishtemodan deinhu dileh, (ishtemodan) mibbene hechaleh.
Uvegine kach, kol innun dela reshimin birshimu kaddisha
1178: Bivsarehon lav innun dileh, veishtemodan dechullehu missitra dimsaavuta atyayn, veasir leitchabbera behu, uleishtae bahadayyhu, bemilloy dekudesha berich hu veasir leodaa lehu mille deorayyta, begin deorayyta kulla shema dekudesha berich hu, vechol at deorayyta, mitkashshera bishma kaddisha. vechol man dela itreshim birshima kaddisha bivsareh, asir leodaa leh milla deorayyta. vekol shekken leishtaddela (nusach acher leistakkela) beh.

Rabbi shimon patach, (Shemot 12:43-44) zot chukkat happasach kol ben nechar lo yochal bo, uchetiv vechol eved ish vegomer. uchetiv toshav vesachir lo yochal bo. uma pischa deihu bisra lemechla, al deitremiz bemilla kaddisha, asir lechol hane lemechal beh, ulemehav lehu lemechal, ad deitgezaru. orayyta dehi kodesh kodashim (dekaddisha) shema illaa dekudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma.

Ribbi elazar shail leribbi shimon avuhi, amar leh, ha tanenan asur lelammed tora leoved kochavim umazzalot, veshappir attearu chavrayyay devavel, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:20) lo asa chen lechol goy, aval kevan deamar maggid devarav leyaakov, amay chukkav umishpatav leyisrael. amar leh, elazar ta chaze, zakkain innun yisrael, dechulaka illaa kaddisha da nata behu kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:2) ki lekach tov natatti lachem, lachem, vela leammin ovde avoda zara.

Uvegin deihi geniza illaa yakkira, shemeh mammash, orayyta kolla satim vegalya, beraza dishmeh. veal da, yisrael bitren dargin innun, satim vegalya, detanenan telat dargin innun mitkashsheran da beda, kudesha berich hu, orayyta, veyisrael. vechol chad, darga al darga, satim vegalya. kudesha berich hu darga al darga, satim vegalya. orayyta hachi name satim vegalya. yisrael hachi name darga al darga, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:19) maggid devarav leyaakov chukkav umishpatav leyisrael. tere dargin innun, yaakov veyisrael, chad galya, vechad satim.

May ka mayyre. ela kol man deitgezar veitreshim bishma (nusach acher bareshavemaa) kaddisha, yahavin leh beinnun millin deitgalleyayn beorayyta, kelomar, modiin leh bereshe atvavn, bereshe pirkin, yahavin aleh chumera defikude orayyta, vela yattir, ad deyistalak bedarga ochora, hada hu dichtiv maggid devarav leyaakov (leyaakov shappir). aval chukkav umishpatav leyisrael, deihu bedarga illaa yattir. uchetiv (Bereshit 35:10) lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov vegomer. chukkav umishpatav leyisrael, illen raze orayyta venimmuse orayyta, vesitre orayyta, dela yitztarchun legallaa ella leman deihu bedarga illaa yattir kadka chaze.

Uma leyisrael hay, leammin ovde avoda zara al achat kamma vechamma, vechol man dela itgezar veyahavin leh afillu at zeera deorayyta, keillu chariv alma, umeshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, decholla behay talya, veda itkeshar, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe lifne bene yisrael. lifne bene yisrael sam, aval lishar ammin la sam. begin kach dabber el bene yisrael. (Vayikra 20) veel bene yisrael tomar. vechen kullehu. yenuchun avahan dealma, innun hilel veshammay, dehachi amru leuneklus, vela odu leh milla deorayyta ad deitgezar.

Veta chaze, milla kadmaa deorayyta, deyahavin linoke, alef bet, da milla dela yachlin bene alma leadbeka besucheltanu, ulesalleka leh biruta, vekol shekken lemallela befumehon. vaafillu malache illae, veilae deilae, la yachlin leadbeka, begin deinnun setimin dishma kaddisha. vaelaf vearba mea vachamesh ribbevan dealmin, kullehu talyayn bekutza dealef, veshivin uteren shemahan kadishin gelifin beatvoy reshimin, dekayymu behu illae vetattae, shemaya veara, vechuresyay yekara demalka, talyayn missitra chada lesitra chada, difshituta dealef, kiuma dealmin kullehu, vesamchin deillain vetattain beraza dechachmeta.
Ushevilin setimin, venaharin amikin, veeser amiran, kullehu nafkin mehahu kotza tattaa ditchot alef. mikkan ulehala share leitpashta alef bevet. velet chusheban lechachmeta dehacha itgelif.
1179: Kach, orayyta kiuma decholla, umehemnuta decholla, lekashshera kishra dimhemnuta da beda kadka chaze. uman deitgezar, itkashar behahu kishra dimhemnuta. uman dela itgezar, vela itkeshar beh, ketiv beh, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. (Shemot 12:48) vechol arel lo yochal bo. deha ittear ruach misava demissitreh, veate leitarva bikdushsha. berich rachamana, defarish leyisrael benoy, reshimin birshima kaddisha, minnayyhu umizuhama dilhon. alayyhu ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek kullo zera emet. uvegine kach, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, vela leochora. torat emet, lezera emet. ata ribbi elazar uneshakeh al yedoy.

Ribbi chizkiyya amar, ketiv (Shmuel 1 12:22) ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo baavur shemo vegomer, ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo, may tama baavur shemo haggadol. begin decholla itkeshar da beda, uvemma itkashsharu yisrael bekudesha berich hu. behahu reshima kaddisha deitreshim bivsarehon. uvegine kach, lo yittosh Adonai et ammo. velamma. baavur shemo haggadol deitreshim behu.

Tana, orayyta ikre berit, vekudesha berich hu ikre berit. vehay reshima kaddisha ikre berit. veal da kolla itkeshar da beda, vela itperash da min da. amar leh ribbi yesa, orayyta veyisrael shappir. aval kudesha berich hu menalan deikre berit. amar leh dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:45) vayyizkor lahem berito, veha ityeyda, veha ittemar.

(Vayikra 18:4) veet chukkotay tishmeru, chukkotay: illen innun nimuse malka. mishpatay: illen innun gizre orayyta, ribbi yehuda amar, kol innun nimusin meatar deikre tzedek, ikrun chukkotay, veinnun gezerat malka. uvechol atar deikre mishpat ikrun dina demalka, deihu malka kaddisha, kudesha berich hu, malka dishlama kolla dileh hu. dehu malka kaddisha, baatar ditren chulakin achidan da beda. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha, veinnun dina verachame. uvegine kach chok umishpat. veal da ketiv (Tehillim 147:19-20) chukkav umishpatav leyisrael. leyisrael vela lishar ammin.

Batreh ma ketiv, lo asa chen lechol goy. vetanenan, af al gav deitgezar vela avid pikkude orayyta, hare hu kegoy becholla, veasir lemelaf leh pitgame orayyta. veal da tanenan (Shemot 20:22) mizbach avanim, da mizbeach avanim mammash. veha kashyu delibbeh beatreh kayyeyma, vezuhama la itpesak mineh. begine kach, la salik bideh hahu geziru, vela mehaneya leh. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 20:22) ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechalleha.

Begine kach, lo asa chen lechol goy setam. umishpatim bal yedaum lealam ulealme almin. milla ochora (nusach acher zeera), la yahavenan lehu, kol shekken raze orayyta, venimusin deorayyta. uchetiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav.

Matnitin, benimuse tehirin. arba maftechin shaviyn, learba sitre alma. bezivyaython ishtechachu. chad listar arba, vearba listar chad. itgallefan (sefer acher atepalegan) bechad gavvna. behahu gavvna, techela, veargevavna vetzeva zehori, vechivvavra, vesumaka. da ayel begavvna dechavreh, vedideh beh rashim.

Arba reshin kachada isteliku, uvechad diyyukena mitdabbekan. chad resha istelik, miggo sachyu deisteche. tere ayyaylta ketzivin beshiura chad, salkan mehahu sachyuta, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:2) keeder hakketzuvot shealu min harachtza. besaara dilhon, chezo deeven tava dearba gavvnin.
Arba gadpin dechasyayn al gufa, vidin zeirin techot gadpayyhu. vechamesh bechamesh gelifan. tasin (sefer acher shaapayn) leella leella mehechala, deshappira bereva veyae lemechoze.

Chad ulem ravya, nappik shinnan charba, demithappecha leguverin lenukevin. natlin limshicha deefa ben shemayya uven ara. lezimnin natlin (sefer acher olin) lah bechol alma, vechol meshichin bah mashichin, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:36) efat tzedek vegomer.
Chad chezo divdolcha, kayyeyma al charba chad, beresha dehahu ravya (nusach acher charba) melahata sumaka miggo bedolcha.
1180: Teren sitrin mehay gisa umehay gisa, itchaze hahu charba, birshimin amikin, chad gevar takkif, olma dekayyeyma 15 almin. chagir hahu charba, lemebad nukemin. immeh chaggirin shittin ochoranin, kullehu mishtalchefe (nusach acher mateyylapey) (sefer acher meshallefe) natzchin kerava, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha. uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 3:8) kullam achuze cherev melummede milchama vegomer. bechamma gavvnin mithappechin anpayyhu, let deyeda lon, bar chad tolata deshat (sefer acher deshari) ben nune yamma, kol avanin deabar alayyhu mitbakkein.

Behahu zimna, kala denafik meinnun dachagire charba, mevaka timnesar turin ravrevin, velet man deyarkin udeneh. kullehu alma setimin ayynin, atimin libba, let man deyashgach deha binyayna listor kad avdin ovadan dela mitkashsheran, satin mearcha detakkena, yemina ade, usemala shalta, keden eryayn ishtechachu. vavy lechayyayvayya degarmin da bealma, deha la mitbarchin leella, ad deyishtetzun innun letatta. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:35) ureshaim od enam barachi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah. (ad kan).

(Vayikra 18) ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle ribbi chiyyay patach. (Shir HaShirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar ken dodi ben habbanim vegomer. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, aval kama chaviva keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu. dehi meshabbachat leh behay. hacha it leistakkela, amay meshabbachat leh betappuach, vela bemilla ochora, o bigvavnin o berecha o betama.

Aval hoil uchetiv tappuach, becholla hi meshabbachat leh, bigvavnin, berecha, uvetama. ma tappuach hu asuvta lecholla, uf kudesha berich hu asuvta lecholla. ma tappuach ishtechach bigvavne, kema deokimna, uf kudesha berich hu ishtechach bigvavnin illain. ma tappuach it beh rucha dakik mikkol shear ilane, uf kudesha berich hu ketiv beh (Hoshea 14:7) vereach lo kallevanon. ma tappuach tameh metika, uf kudesha berich hu ketiv beh (Shir HaShirim Adonai:16) chikko mamtakkim.

Vekudesha berich hu meshabbach lah likkeneset yisrael keshoshanna, veha okimna mile, amay keshoshanna, veha ittemar. ribbi yehuda amar, beshaata deasgiu zakkae bealma, keneset yisrael salleka rechin tavin, umitbarcha mimmalka kaddisha, veanpaha nehirin. uvezimna deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, kivyachol keneset yisrael la salleka rechin tavin, veatamat missitra ochora merira. keden, ketiv (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz vegomer, veanpaha chashochan.

Ribbi yose amar, beshaata deasgiu zakkain bealma, ketiv (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. uvezimna deasgiu chayyayvin bealma, ketiv (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino. ribbi chizkiyya amar mehacha, (Mishlei 16:28) venirgan mafrid alluf, kelomar parish malka min matronita, hada hu dichtiv ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ kame avoy, amar leh, i peraklita bealma bematronita ishtechach, vei kategorya bealma, bematronita ishtechach, amay. amar leh, lemalka dehava leh bar mimatronita, kol zimna dehahu bera avid reuta demalka, malka avid madoreh bematronita. vechol zimna dela hava hahu bar avid reuta demalka, malka parish madoreh mimmatronita.

Kach kudesha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael, kol zimna deyisrael avdin reuta dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu shavvi madoreh bichneset yisrael. vechol zimna deyisrael la avdin reuta dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu la shavvi madoreh bikkeneset yisrael. may tama. begin deyisrael hu bera buchera dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. imma, da hi keneset yisrael dichtiv, (Mishlei 11) veal tittosh torat immecha.

Ta chaze, kol zimna deyisrael rachakin mehechala demalka, kivyachol matronita itrachakat immehon. may tama. begin dematronita la akdimat kista lehay bar, lealkaa leh, lemehach beorach meshar. begin demalka la alke livreh lealmin. ella shavik kolla bida dematronita, leanhaga hechala, ulealkaa berah, uledabbera leh beorach keshot, lokovleh demalka.
