1181: Veraza demilla dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:1) divre lemoel melech massa asher yisserattu immo (immo vadday), da bat sheva, veha ittemar ketiv, (Mishlei 10:1) mishle shelomo ben chacham yesammach av uven kesil tugat immo. tugat immo vadday. chame ma ketiv, ben chacham yesammach av, beod dehay bar azil beorach meshar, vehu chakkima, yesammach av (kelal), da malka kaddisha leella. yesammach av setam. ishtechach hay bar beorcha tekala, ma ketiv uven kesil tugat immo. tugat immo vadday, da keneset yisrael. veraza demilla ketiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishachem shullecha immechem.

Ta chaze, la ishtechach chedvavta kame kudesha berich hu, keyoma desalik shelomo lechachmeta, veamar shir hashshirim. keden nehiru anpoy dematronita, veate malka lemishre madoreh immah. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo vegomer. may vatterev. desalleka shepiru dematronita, veitrabbiat bedargaha al kol shear dargin, begin demalka shavvi madoreh bah. vechol kach lamma. begin deappikat bera chakkima da lealma. (nusach acher lemalka)

Vechad appikat leh lishlomo, lechol yisrael appikat, vechullehu havo bedargin illain zakkain kishlomo (sefer acher bishlama). dekudesha berich hu chadde behu, veinnun beh. uveyoma deshachlal shelomo beta letatta, atkinat matronita beta lemalka. veshauu madorehon kachada, unehiru anpaha bechedva shelimu. keden ishtechach chedvavta lecholla, leella vetatta. vechol kach lamma. begin dichtiv, massa asher yisserattu immo, dedabberat leh liruta demalka.

Vechad hay bar kema daamena, (sefer acher deitzterich) la itdevar liruteh demalka. keden hi eryayta decholla, eryayta dechol sitrin deha malka parish mimmatronita, umatronita itrachakat mehechaleh, uvegin kach eryayta hi decholla. vechi la eryayta hu, malka bela matronita, umatronita bela malka. veal da ketiv, ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle immecha hi. immecha hi vadday, vesharya immach, begine kach lo tegalle ervatah.

Rabbi shimon akish yedoy uvacha, veamar vavy i ema vegalena raza, vavy i la ema, deyevdun chavrayyay milla. (Yechezkel 11:13) ahah Adonai elohim kala atta ose et sheerit yisrael. may ahah. umay kala atta ose. ella raza demilla, bezimna de tattaa itterachat mehechala demalka, Adonai ochora illaa beginah manat birchata. ucheden ketiv, ahah kala atta ose. begin dechad ihi (nusach acher hay Adonai) itmenaat mibbirchan, Adonai ochora manat lon mikkolla. may taama. begin devirkan la mishtakkeche, ella baatar desharyayn dechar venukeba.

Veal da ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 25:30) Adonai mimmarom yishag umimmeon kadsho yitten kolo shaog yishag al navihu. al navihu mammash. da matronita, veda hu vadday. umay omer. oy shehecheravti et beti vechulei. beti ziuuga dematronita. veda hu vadday, ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle. deha mikkol sitrin eryayta hu. ucheden, (Yeshayahu 50:3) lavshu shamayim kadrut vesak husam kesutam deha atar achasanat birchan demabbuin denachalin dahavo negidin veshakyayn kadka chazu, itmenau.

Tanenan, kad itperash malka mimmatronita, uvirkan la mishtakkechan, keden ikre 16. may tama 16. detanya, resha diyyesod 10, deha yesod 6 zeera hu, vekudesha berich hu 6 ravreva illaa. veal da ketiv vav teren vavin kachada, veresha dehay yesod 10 hu. vechad itrachakat matronita mimmalka, uvirkan itmenau mimmalka, veziuuga la ishtechach beresha diyyesod, natil 6 illaa lehay resha diyyesod dehu 10, venagid leh legabbeh, keden hu 16, 16 lecholla, leillain vetattain.

Veal da tanenan, miyyoma deitchariv yerushalam, birchan la ishtechachu bealma, velet lach yom dela ishtechach beh levavtin, deha birchan itmenau bechol yom. amar leh, o hachi, oy o hoy, (nusach acher o vaAdonai) mahu.
Amar leh, kad milla talya bitshuva, vela tayyvin, keden Adonai illaa natil lon, veangid levav vey, legabbah,
1182: Begin dela tayyvin, keden ikre hoy. hoy kad istallak malka leella leella, vetzavvchin bene nasha vela ashgach behu. vehahu illaa ehye temira, salik lev, vey legabbeh, begin dela itkebil tzeloteh, keden ikre oy, deha 1 salik legabbeh dev vey. (sefer acher dehu 1 salik gabbeh laAdonai 6 40) ucheden teshuva la ishtechach. veal da istallak meillen atvavn Adonai, deha bitshuva la talyay.

Vadday kad asgiu chove alma tefe, uteshuva hava talya bekadmita, vela bau, keden istallak Adonai, 7 salik lev yod legabbeh, veikre oy. vechad chariv be makdesha, uteshuva istalakat (velo mealleya), keden tzavvchu veamru, (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki fana hayyom. may ki fana hayyom. da hu yoma illaa, deikre teshuva, deistallak veitavar, vela shechiach. hahu yoma deishtemoda, lefashta yemina lekabbela chayyayvin, veha itpene mikkolla, vela ishtechach, veal da amru oy, vela hoy. ki yinnatu tzille arev, deha ityeyhiv reshu leravreve memanan dishar ammin, lemishlat alayyhu.

Tana, salik 6 leella leella, vehechala ittokad, veamma itgele, umatronita itterachat, uveta itcharavat. levatar kad nachit 12 leatreh, ashgach beveteh veha itchariv, bae lematronita, veha itrachakat veazlat. chama lehechaleh, veha ittokad. baa leamma, veha itgele. chama levirkan denachalin amikin dahavo nagdin, veha itmenau. keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 22:12) vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekarcha velachagor sak. ucheden lavshu shamayim kadrut.

Keden 6 Adonai (sefer acher 6 10) itnegid chad lokovel chad. vaAdonai illaa, nagid mabbue lesitra ochora, uvirkan la mishtakkechan. deha dechar venukeba la ishtechachu, vela sharyayn kachada. keden (Yirmeyahu 25:30) shaog yishag al navihu. bacha rabbi shimon, uvacha ribbi elazar, amar ribbi elazar, bechiyay tekia belibbai missitra chada, vechedvavta belibbai missitra ochora. deha shemana millin, dela shemana ad hasheta, zakkaa chulaki.

(Vayikra 18) ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle, man eshet avicha. amar rabbi shimon, ha tanenan, kol milloy deorayyta satim vegalya, kema dishma kaddisha satim vegalya, orayyta dehi shema kaddisha, hachi name satim vegalya. hacha kolla beitgalyay, yedia satim kema deokimna.

Vehay kera hachi hu, eshet avicha: tana, kol zimna dematronita ishtechachat bemalka, veyanka lach, ikre immecha. hasheta deitgalya immach veitrachakat min malka, eshet avicha itkere. intu hi demalka kaddisha la itpetarat betiruchin minneh, inteteh hi vadday. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) ko amar Adonai e ze sefer keritut immechem asher shillachtiha. ella vadday intu hi demalka, af al gav deitgalyay.

Veal da pakid ala tere zimne, kad yatva bemalka beziuuga chad, veitkere immecha, dichtiv ervat immecha lo tegalle, la taavid deyitrachakun da min da, vetishtelach al chovach, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shulcha immechem. vechad, kad hi begaluta immach, veitgalyay mehechala demalka, veitkere intu demalka. af al gav deitrachakat minneh la taavid begin detade mibbenach, veyishletun bach sanach, vela tistamar alach begaluta. hada hu dichtiv ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle. may taama. begin ki ervat avicha hu. af al gav deitrachakat min malka, ashgachuta demalka bah tedira, uvaya leistammera lokovla yattir, vela techuv legabbah.

Ribbi shimon patach, (Devarim 23:15) ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha lehatztzilcha vegomer. ki Adonai elohecha: da shechinta, deishtechachat behu beyisrael, vekol shekken begaluta, leaggana alayhu tedira mikkol sitrin, umikkol shear ammin, dela yeshetzun lehu leyisrael.
1183: Sanehon deyisrael leavasha lehu, ad deyisrael machalishin chela dishchinta mikkamme ravreve memanan dishar ammin. keden yachlin lehon sanehon deyisrael, veshaltin alayyhu, vegazrin alayyhu kama gezerin bishin. vechad innun tayyvin lokovla, hi metabbarat chela vetukepa dechol innun memanan ravrevin, vetavrat chela vetukepa desanehon deyisrael, veitpara lehu mikkolla.

Veal da vehaya machanecha kadosh, devae bar nash dela yisteav bechovoy, vayyaavar al pitgame orayyta. dei avid hache, mesaavin leh, kema dichtiv venitmetem bam, belo 1. vetana, matan utemanya vearbein shayyfin begufa, vechullehu istaavan, kad ihu isteav. kelomar, kad bae leistaava. veal da, vehaya machanecha kadosh. may machanecha, illen innun shayyfe gufa. velo yire vecha ervat davar, may ervat davar. eryayta nucheraa lehay (sefer acher dahave) davar ramaz, kema deokimna. dei hachi, veshav meacharecha vadday. veal da ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle. may tama. begin dichtiv ervat avicha hu, kema deokimna.
Tana, al 3 millin mitakkevin yisrael begaluta. al deavdin kelana bishchinta begaluta. umehaddere anpayyhu min shechinta, veal dimsaave garmayyhu kame shechinta. vechullehu okimna bematnita dilan.

Ribbi abba, hava azil lekapputekiyya, vahava immeh ribbi yose. ad dahavo azle, chamu chad bar nash, dehava ate, ureshima chad beanpoy. amar ribbi abba, niste mehay orcha, deha anpoy deden ashidu aleh, deavar beeryayta deorayyta, begine kach itreshim beanpoy. amar leh ribbi yose, i hay reshima hava leh kad hava yanuka, may eryayta ishtechach beh. amar leh, ana chamena beanpoy, deashidu beeryayta deorayyta.

Kara leh ribbi abba, amar leh ema milla, hay reshima deanpach, ma hu. amar lon, bematota minnayychu, la taanshu yattir lehahu bar nash, deha chovoy ka garmu leh. amar ribbi abba mahu. amar leh, yoma chad havina azil bearcha ani vaachoti, sharena bechad oshpiza, veravina chamra, vechol hahu lelya achidna baachoti. betzafra kamna, veushepizai katat bechad gavra, ayelna benayyhu, vekatru li da mehay gisa, veda mehay gisa, ureshima da hava ayel leve mocha, veishtezavna al yeda dechad asyay deit begavavn.

Amar leh, man hu asyay. amar leh, ribbi samlay hu. amar leh may asuvta yahav lecha. amar leh asuvta denafsha. umehahu yoma ahadarna bitshuva. uvechol yoma chazena anpai bechad chezu, uvachena kame kudesha berich hu, dehu ribbon almin al hahu chova. umeinnun dimin aschena anpai. amar ribbi abba, i lav deitmena minach teshuva, avarna meanpach hahu reshima. aval karena alaych, (Yeshayahu 6:7) vesar avonecha vechattatch techuppar. amar leh, 3 zimnin ema. amar leh 3 zimnin, veitavar reshima.

Amar ribbi abba, vadday marach ha baa leabera minach, devadday bitshuva ishtechachat. amar leh, nadarna mehay yoma leitasseka beorayyta yemama velelya. amar leh, ma shemach. amar leh elazar. amar leh el azar, vadday shema garim, deelahach siyyeyach, vahava besaadach, shadreh rivi abba uvarcheh.

Lezimna ochora, hava ribbi abba azil legabbe rabbi shimon, al bemateh, ashkacheh dehava yativ vedarish, (Tehillim 92:7) ish baar lo yeda uchesil lo yavin et zot. ish baar lo yeda vegomer, kama tippeshin innun bene alma, dela mashgichin vela yadin vela mistakkelin leminda orchoy dekudesha berich hu, al ma kayymin bealma. man meakkev lehu leminda, tippeshuta dilhon. begin dela mishtaddele beorayyta, deillu havo mishtaddele beorayyta yindeun orchoy dekudesha berich hu.
Uchesil lo yavin et zot, dela mistachal vela yada
1184: Nimuse dezot bealma. (deaf al gav) dedain alma bedinoy vechaman ledinoy dehay zot, dematan al bene nasha deinnun zakkain, vela matan al rashiayay chayyayvin, deavrin al pitgame orayyta, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:8) bifroach reshaim kemo esev vegomer. dehay alma yartin leh bechol sitroy, vedinin la matun aloy behay alma. veilmale dedavid malka odeh besofeh dikra, la yadenan, dichtiv lehishshamdam ade ad, leshetzaa lehon mehahu alma, ulemehevi afra techot raglehon detzaddikayyay, dichtiv, (Malachi 3:21) veassotem reshaim ki yihyu efer tachat kappot raglechem.

Tu patach veamar, (Iyov 16:8) vayyakam bi chachashi befanay yaane. bemay ka mayyre. ella, zakkaa chulakeh debar nash deishtaddal beorayyta, leminda orchoy dekudesha berich hu. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, keillu ishtaddal bishmeh mammash. ma shemeh dekudesha berich hu avid nimusin. uf orayyta hachi name. ta chaze, hay man deavar al pitgame orayyta, orayyta salleka venachta veavda beh bebar nash reshimin beanpoy, begin deyistakkelun beh illae vetattae, vechullehu oshdan levavtin al resheh.

Vetana, kol innun ene Adonai, deazlin veshatin bealma leminda orchoy divne nasha, kullehon zakfin ayynin, umistakkelin beanpoy dehahu bar nash, vechaman lehu, vechullehu patchin aleh vavy vavy. vavy leh behay alma, vavy leh bealma deate. istelaku missocharaneh diflanya, deha sahaduta beanpoy, verucha dimsaava sharya aloy. vechol innun yomin deishtechach reshimu beanpoy lesahaduta, i olid bar, ashlif leh rucha missitra dimsaava. veillen innun chayyayve dara, takife anpin, demarehon shavik lehon behay alma, leshetzaa lehu bealma deate.

Tanenan, hay tzaddika zakkaa deishtedal beorayyta yemama velelya, kudesha berich hu mashich aleh chad chuta dechesed, veitreshim leh beanpoy, umehahu reshima dachale illae vetattae. hachi name man deavar al pitgame orayyta, mashchan aleh rucha dimsaava, veitreshim leh beanpoy, uminneh arkin illae vetattae. vecholla machreze aleh, istelaku missacharaneh diflanya, deavar al pitgame orayyta, veal pikkude demareh, vavy leh, vavy lenafsheh. hay ashlif rucha dimsaava, deishtechach immeh, veorit leh livreh, vehay hu dekudesha berich hu let leh beh chulaka, veshavik leh, leshetzaa leh lealma deate.

Amar leh ribbi abba, shappir kaamrat, mena lach hay. amar leh hachi olifna. veolifna, dehay yeruta bisha, achasinun kullehu benoy, i la yetuvun, deha let milla kayyeyma kame teshuva. vaana hachi olifna, deasuvta da yahavu li zimna chada, dahavina reshim beanpay, veyoma chad havina azil beorcha, veiarana bechad zakkaa, veal yedoy itabbar minnay hahu reshima. amar li, ma shemach. amar leh elazar, vekare alay elazar ochora. amar leh, berich rachamana, dachamena lach, vezachena lemecheme lach behay. zakkaa chulakach bealma den uvealma deate, (amar leh) ana hu deirana lach.

Ishtattach kameh, ayyteh leveteh, atkin kameh kuretisa (sefer acher tarekavesaa) (taretaysaay) denahama, uvisra deegla telitaa. batar deachlu, amar leh hahu gavra, ribbi, ema li chad milla, chadda torata sumaka it li, imma deegla devisra da daachilna, veyoma chad ad la itabberat veolidat, azilna batraa lemara lemadbera, ad dedabbarna lah abar kamay chad gavra, amar leh, ma shemah detorata da. amena, min yoma deityeylidat la karenna lah bishma. amar leh, bat sheva em shelomo itkere, i tizke lechappara. vaana beod deahadarna reshay, la chamena leh, vechayichna mehahu milla.
1185: Vehasheta dezachina beorayyta, ittearna al hahi milla, umin yoma deitpetar ribbi samlay mehacha, la hava bar nash deyanhir lan beorayyta kevavteh. vaana dachilna lememar milla deorayyta dela olifna. umilla da deistakkalna demilla dechachmeta hi, vela yedana. amar leh, vadday milla dechachmeta hi, uremiza illaa hi leella uletatta.

Aval ta chaze, bat sheva itkere mammash beraza dechachmeta. begin kach ketiv bah kolla besheva. 7 parot. 7 serefot. 7 hazaot. 7 kibbusim. 7 temeim. 7 tehorim. 7 kohanim. umoshe veaharon bechushebna deha ketiv, vaydabber Adonai el moshe veaharon vegomer. veshappir kaamar hahu gavra, deamar bat sheva, vecholla raza dechachmeta hi.

Amar leh, berich rachamana deshamana milla da. berich hu deha akdim li shelam bekadmita, lemizke lehay. dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar Adonai. ana kad havina rachok, kudesha berich hu akdim li shelam lemehevi karov. kara aleh ribbi abba, (Shmuel 1 25:6) atta shalom uvetcha shalom vechol asher lecha shalom.

(Vayikra 18) ervat achot avicha lo tegalle. ribbi chiyyay patach, veish asher yikkach et achoto bat aviv o vat immo veraa et ervatah vegomer. tamman tanenan, mea utelatin shenin, itperash adam meitteteh, vela hava olid. middekatal kayin lehevel, la baa adam leizdavvevga beitteteh. ribbi yose amar, mishaata deitgezar aleh veal kol alma mita, amar, amay ana olid livattuta. miyyad itperash meitteteh.

Uteren ruchin nukevin, havo atyayn veizdavvevgan immeh, veolidu. veinnun deolidu havo mazzikin dealma, veikrun nige bene adam. veillen satan livne adam, vesharyayn befitcha deveta, uvevirae, uvevatte kise. veal da bar nash, deishtechach befitcha deveteh shema kaddisha shadday bechitrin illain, kullehu arkan veitrachakan minneh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:10) venega la yikrav beoholecha. may venega la yikrav. illen nige bene adam.

Vetana, beshaata denachat adam bediyyukena illaa, bediyyukena kaddisha, vechamu leh illae vetattae, kullehu kerivu gabbeh, veamlechuhu al hay alma. batar deata chivya al chavva, veatil bah zuhama, levatar olidat kayin. (Bereshit 178 amud alef) mittamman (sefer acher nateyychasev) nitchayyvu kol darin chayyayvin dealma. umadora deshedin veruchin, mittamman ishtechachu, umissitroy. uvegine kach kol ruchin veshedin, palguta it behu mibbene nasha diltatta, ufalguta mimmalache illae dilella. vechen kad ityeylidu meadam innun ochoranin, kullehu ishtechachu kehay gavvna, palgu mittattae, ufalgu meillae.

Batar deityeylidu meadam, (sefer acher ahadru leh ketzat meinnun ruchin denafku mateyavabetayh bechelma) olid meinnun ruche benatan, dedamyan lishpiru deilae, ulishpiru detattae. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 6:2) vayyiru vene haelohim et benot haadam ki tovot henna vegomer, vetaan kolla batrayyhu. vechad dechura ishtechach, deata lealma mirucheh desitra dekayin, vekarun leh tuval kayin. vachada nukeba nafkat immeh, vahavu biryayn vetaan batraa, veitkere naama. minnah nafku ruchin veshedin ochoranin. veinnun (Bereshit 92 amud alef, 16 amud alef, 143 amud bet, 205 amud alef) talyayn baavira, veodin millin leinnun ochoranin dishchichin letatta.

Veda tuval kayin, appik zayyne kittula lealma. veda naama itregishat berigshaha, veitdabbekat besitraha. vead kean hi kayyeyma, umadoraha ben rigshe yamma rabba, venafkat vechayyeychat bivne nasha, veitchammemat minnayyhu bechelma, behahu tiuveta debar nash, veitdabbekat beh. tiuveta natlat vela yattir. umehahu tiuveta itabberat, veappikat zaynin ochoranin lealma.
Veillen benin deolidat mibbene nasha, mishtakkechin lokovle nukeve bene nasha, umitabberan minnayyhu, veolidan ruchin, vechullehu azlin lelilit kadmita, vehi megaddelet lon. vehi nafkat lealma, uvaya
1186: Ravyayha, vechamat ravye bene nasha, veitdabbekat behu, lekatla lehu, uleishteava beruchayyhu deravye bene nasha vehi azlat behahu rucha (nusach acher ravya), veizdammenan tamman 3 ruchin kaddishin, vetasin kammah, venatlin hahu rucha (nusach acher ravya) minnah, umanichin leh kame kudesha berich hu, vetamman mitgallefe (sefer acher matealepay) kammeh.

Begine kach orayyta azharat lehu livne nasha, vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim vadday. i ishtechach bar nash kaddisha, la mistafe minnah, dichden zammin kudesha berich hu leillen 3 malachin kaddishin deamaran, venatrin leh lehahu ravyay, vehi la yachla leavasha leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha. may taama lo teunne elecha raa. begin ki malachav yetzavve lach, uchetiv (tehillim 90) ki vi chashak vaafalletehu.

Dei bar nash la ishtechach kaddisha, veashlif rucha missitra dimsaava, keden hi atya vechayyeychat beh behahu ravya. vei kattilat leh, ishteavat behahu rucha, vela tade mineh lealmin. vei tema innun ochoranin, dekattilat lon, veizdamnu kammah innun telata kaddishin, venatlin minnah hahu rucha, ha la besitra dimsaava ishtechachu, amay shalta lekatla lehu. ella, hay kad bar nash la itkaddash, aval la itkavvavn leistaava vela isteav, begin kach yachla leshalletaa begufa, vela berucha.

Vezimnin ishtechach denafkat naama lealma, leitchamma mibbene nasha, vishtechach bar nash bekishra (nusach acher bakeshaveya) detiuveta immah, veittear mishshenateh, veachid beinteteh, veshachiv ima, ureuta dile behahu tiuveta dehavi leye bechalme, keden hahu bar deolid, missitra denaama ka atya, deha betiuveta dilah ishtechach hay, kad nafka lilit vechamat leh, yadat milla, vehi itketarat beh, umagdelat leh keinnun ochoranin benoy denaama, veishtechachat immeh zimnin saggiin, vela katala leh.

Hay hu bar nash, divchol sihara vesihara itpegim, vela ityaasha minneh lealmin, deha bechol sihara vesihara kad itchaddesha bealma, lilit nafka, ufakda al kullehu dehi magdelat, vechayyeycha behu, ucheden hahu bar nash pagim behahu zimna, zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demitkaddeshe bikdushsha demalka, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato vegomer.
Millin illen galle shelomo malka, besifra deashmeday malka, veashkachna beh (79 amud alef) elaf vearba mea vachamesh zine mesaavuta, demistaave behu bene nasha. degalle da ashmeday lishlomo malka.

Vavy lehu livne nasha, dechullehu atimin usetimin ayynin, vela yadin, vela shamin, vela mashgichin, hech kayymin bealma. veha eta veasvuta kamayyhu, vela mistakkelin. deha la yachlin bene nasha leishtezava, ella beeta deorayyta. dichtiv, (Devarim 23:11) ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere layla. asher lo yihye tahor dayyka, mikkere layla dayyka, veha okimna mille, beeta deorayyta kaddisha. dehachi ketiv beorayyta kaddisha, vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki ani Adonai elohechem.

Tana, batar deistalaku kayin vehevel, ithaddar adam leinteteh, veitlabbash berucha ochora, veolid leshet. mikkan ityaychasu dare detzaddikayyay bealma. veasge kudesha berich hu chesed bealma, uvechol chad ityeylidat nukeba immeh, leityayshsheva alma kegavvna dilella. veha ukemuha chavrayyay bistimaa dematnitin, dichtiv, (Vayikra 20:17) veish asher yikkach et achoto bat aviv o vat immo vegomer, chesed hu. chesed hu vday, uvatar deshari chesed, gizin vesharashin nafkin mittechot leella, veitparshan anpin, vekariv itrechak. keden anpa asge, veate leitchabbera beziuuga chad beilana. hay bekadmita, hay bistima dealma. begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:3) amarti olam chesed yibbane. aval mikkan ulehala bene nasha deyishtachchun beh, venichretu leene bene ammam.
1187: Tana ervat achot avicha, kema deitgalyay bistima. ketiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam vegomer, zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deyade archoy dekudesha berich hu, veazlin behu, veishtemodan gabbayyhu. zakkaa chulakehon.

Tana, itabberat hei illaa birchimuta vachavivuta dela mitperash minnah yod lealmin. itabberat veappikat vav, levatar kaim kammah, veyanka leh. veda (nusach acher vedain bealma) vav kad nafka, bat zugo nafka immeh. atya chesed ittear gabbeh, ufarish lon, venafku gizin mittechot leella, veitpashshatu anfin, veasgiu, veitavidat hei tattaa. veitrabbiat beanpaha leella leella, ad deizdavvevgat beilana illaa, veitchabbaru vav im hei, man garim lon. chesed hu. chesed hu vadday. dechibber lon kachada.

Yod im hei illaa. la talya chibbura dilhon bechesed, ella bemazzala talyay chibbura dilhon, vachavivuta dilhon, dela (sefer acher amud bet) mitparshan lealmin. yod itkashar beHei, vehe itkashar beVav, vav itkashar beHei, vehe itkashar becholla. vecholla chad kishshura hu, vechad milla. la itperashu da min da lealmin. kivyachol, man degarim piruda, keillu chariv alma, veikre eryayta decholla.

Ulezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu leatava shechinta leatraha, uleishtakkecha kolla beziuuga chad dichtiv (Zecharya 14:20) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad vegomer. vei tema hasheta lav hu echad. la, deha hasheta chayyayve alma garmu, dela ishtechach chad. deha matronita itrachakat min malka, vela mishtakkeche beziuuga. imma illaa itrachakat min malka vela yanka leh.

Begin demalka bela matronita, la mitatter beitroy immah (sefer acher deima), kema bekadmita kad itchabbar bematronita, deattera leh, bechamma itrin, bechamma zehirin beitrin kaddishin illain. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon (sefer acher amud bet, Shemot 84 amud alef) bammelech shelomo vegomer, deizdevvavg bematronita, keden attera leh imma illaa kedka yeot. vehasheta dela ishtechach malka bematronita, keden imma illaa natlat kitraa (nusach acher ateraah) umanaat minneh mabbue denachalin, vela ishtechach bekishshura chad. kivyachol la ishtechach chad.

Uvezimna detetuv matronita laatar hechala, umalka yizdavvivg immah beziuuga chad. keden, yitchabbar kolla kachada, bela piruda, veal da ketiv, bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. bayom hahu: bezimna (171) diytuv matronita lehechala, keden kolla ishtechach chad bela piruda. ucheden (Ovadya 1:21) vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot vegomer.

Detanya, amar ribbi shimon, la teul matronita bechedvavta behechaleh ad deyitdan malchuta deesav, vetisav minneh nukemin degarma kol hay. levatar tizdavvivg bemalka, vihe chedu shelim, hada hu dichtiv, vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav bekadmita, ulevatar vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. man melucha, da matronita. hada hu dichtiv, vehayta laAdonai hammelucha. ulevatar deyizdavvevgun kachada, ma ketiv. vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

(Vayikra 18) ervat achi avicha lo tegalle. tane ribbi yehuda, da yisrael letatta. vaachot immecha: da yerushalam diltatta. divchovin illen, yiglun yisrael bene ammayay, veyitchariv yerushala 40 letatta. veal da tanenan, rechimuta dekudesha berich hu dekara leyisrael achim, shenneemar (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay adabbera na vegomer. (veokimna milin vetamman 2 bat benah uvat bittah vechulei veaf al gav deinnun beitgalleyay vabeatekaseya vechen batreh. deha alma itzterich lon, veinnun yishshuva dealma kema dichtiv 3 reecha vara avicha) vehay raza demila. deamar rabbi shimon

Amar ribbi yehuda, i achay lamma reay, vei reay lamma achay. ella tana, hahu milla dela itade lealmin, ikre rea, kema deat amer reacha verea avicha al taazov. vehay raza demilla deamar rabbi shimon, ima illaa, raya ikre, begin dela itade (sefer acher amud bet) rechimuta deabba minnah
1188: Lealmin. veima tattaa kala ikre, veikre achot, kema deokimna (Shir HaShirim 8:8) achot lanu ketanna.

Vehayeynu setam matnita dilan, dichtiv hacha, ervat achotcha vat avicha o vat immecha, kevan deamar vat avicha, may o vat immecha. ella, i missitra deabba ishtechachat, chachma itkere. vei missitra deima, bina itkere. veal kol panim ben hay uven hay, meima veabba ishtechachat. deha yod la itade min Adonai lealmin. veda hu raza demilla, moledet bayit: missitra deabba. o moledet chutz: missitra deima.

Ribbi abba amar, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit, man hu bayit deitbene bechachma. havi ema da nahar denafik meeden, begine kach moledet bayit. o moledet chutz. kad nafkat min 6, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:23) etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari. uchetiv (Bereshit 2:21) vayikkach achat mitztzalotav, veda hu moledet chutz, meatar dizer anpin ishtechach, kema deittemar.

Veal da amar ribbi yehuda, yisrael achin ikrun lekudesha berich hu, dela ade rechimuta dilhon lealmin. yerushalam diltatta achot immecha itkere, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:3) yerushala 40 habbenuya keir shechubbera lah yachdav vegomer. may shechubbera lah yachdav. begin deizdevvavg bah malka mishshit sitrin, bechol sitre malka, bedarga detzaddik, vechol kitre malka kelilan beh. vehayeynu shechubbera lah yachdav.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah. man shevatim. illen teresar techumin, demitparshan mehahu ilana rabba vetakkif, deachasin lon missitra deabba veimma. hada hu dichtiv shivte yah, mishfar sahaduta, deashid bera kaddisha (295) (nusach acher deashid abba veema bivra kaddisha) dichtiv shivte yah edut leyisrael, veinnun naharin amikin, denagdin veitmashshechan min yah. vecholla (sefer acher vechol kach lamma). lehodot leshem Adonai. (sefer acher uvegin kach) ki shamma yashvu chisot lemishpat kisot levet david, leachsena malchuta kaddisha hu uvenoy ledare darin, veda hi shirata deamar david al malchu illaa kaddisha.

Ribbi chizkiyya amar, kolla beraza illaa hu, leachazaa deman defagim letatta, pagim leella. ervat kallatcha lo tegalle, detanenan onatan shel talmide chachamim mishshabbat leshabbat. begin deyadin raza demilla, vichavvevnun libba, veyishtekach reutehon shelim. uvenin deolidu ikrun benin demalka. vei illen pegimu milla letatta, kivyachol pagmin innun bechalla dilella, keden ketiv ervat kallatcha lo tegalle. da begin innun deyadin orchin deorayyta. shear amma hahu deitgalya, kallatcha mammash, uvechova da shechinta istelakat mibbenayyhu.

Tana, itgalif shema kaddisha besitrin yedian, beatvavn reshimin deesrin uteren (sefer acher 10 3, 1 12, 10 4, 2 12, 10 3, 2 baAdonai, 6 5, 10 baAdonai, 10 5, Adonai 12, 3 baAdonai, Adonai 6 ellu hashsheni navesacheavet matzanu baheatekavet asher lefanenu) 10 be, 1 bey. 10 bev, 2 bey. 6 be Adonai beg, yod beHei, yod begyml, hei beYod 83 beHei, hei bedlt (10 6, 4 12. 10 baAdonai. 10 5. Adonai 12. 3 12. 6 12). kullehu mitgallefe beYod, yod salik lon.
Hei kalil beYod, minneh nafkat, keden meatterin laavahan. itpattechat hei benachloy, veattar leresha dev, detamman sharyayn avahan.

6 Kalil shit atvavn, vechullehu kalil yod. 10 (yod) itgelif begilufoy, vesalik leitattera bitresar atvavn ochoranin, minneh nafku eser amiran begilufoy, vechullehu shevilin deorcha illaa, (sefer acher daavarechan deorayyta) yakkira decholla. keden hei ochora itkelilat min kullehu, gelifa missitra meticha (sefer acher mateyychadea) temira, leolada letatta.
Itgelifu (sefer acher atepaleygev) kullehu bearbein uteren atvavn, vechullehu parishna bematnita didan, vechullehu salkan beresha demalka.

Sheva shavattin shelemin, mitparshin beshivin atvavn. shivin uteren istelaku, veistellaku beot 6 (sefer acher yod), reshiman 82 vayhi beshallach paro bekra vayyissa vayyavo vayyet. kad natlat shechinta, vez reshimin itreshimu beh, shiva istelaku
1189: Minneh, beatvavn reshimin. tana, istelaku atvavn birshimin yedian, vearchin setimin, bar lezakkae keshot, samche alma.

Amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar, ta chaze, hane esrin uteren atvavn diglifin beorayyta, kullehu mitparshan behane (nusach acher meillen) eser amiran. kol amira vaamira meillen eser, deinnun kitre malka kullehu gelifin beatvavn yedian (davar acher acharanin), begine kach shema kaddisha itkasseyay beatvavn ochoranin, vechol amira, ozif laamira illaa minnah atvoy, begin deitkelil hay behay. veal da shema kaddisha, galifna leh beatvavn ochoranin, begin deitkasyayn da beda, veda beda, ad demitkashsheran kullehu kachada.

Uman devae leminda tzirufe shemahan kaddishin, linda innun atvavn dirshimin bechol kitra vechitra, ucheden linda veyitkeyyaym becholla. veha galifna lon, bechol innun atvavn dirshiman vidian bechol kitra vechitra, missifra ilaa dishlomo. vehachi salik bidan, vechavrayyay gelifin lon, (sefer acher valechaberayya galeynen lon) veshappir hu, deha kol kitra vechitra ozif lechavreh atvoy, kema deokimna, ulezimnin dela itzterich ella, beatvoy innun dirshimin beh. vechullehu yedian legabbe chavrayyay veha okimna lon.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay bealma den uvealma deate, dekudesha berich hu bae bikarehon, umegale lehon razin illain dishmeh kaddisha, dela galle leillain kaddishin, veal da yachil moshe, leitattera bene kaddishin, vechullehu la yachle lemikrav bahadeh, kenura yakidta, vegumere deeshsha. dei lav hachi, man hava leh lemoshe, lemekam benayyhu. ella zakkaa chulaka demoshe, deha kad share lemallela immeh kudesha berich hu, baa leminda shemeh kaddisha (sefer acher shamevay kaddishin), satim vegalya, bechol chad vechad kadka chaze, ucheden adbak veyada yattir mikkol bene alma.

Ta chaze, beshaata desalik moshe go anana yakkira, al bene kaddishin. paga beh chad malacha beshalhove nura, beayynin melahatan, vegadpoy mokdan, baa leshaafa leh begavvivy. vehahu malacha gavriel (sefer acher 251) (sefer acher 291) (177) shemeh, keden adkar moshe chad shema kaddisha. dehava galif bitresar atvavn, veizdaza veitregash, ad desalik moshe benayyhu. vechen lechol chad vechad, zakkaa chulakeh (Shemot 58 amud alef) veha okimna mile.

Ervat ishsha, uvittah lo tegalle. tana, betikkune matronita okimna illen eryayn, af al gav deinnun (nusach acher eryayn inun) beitgalyay uvistima, vetamman bat benah uvat bittah. deha alma itzterich lon, veinnun yishshuva dealma, kema deokimna. uman degalle chad eryayta minnayyhu, vavy leh, vavy lenafsheh, deha galle begin da eryayn ochoranin.

Vetanya milla batraa deeser amiran deorayyta, (Shemot 20:14) lo tachmod eshet reecha, begin dehay kelala dechullehu. uman dechamid itteta ochora, keillu abar al orayyta kulla. beram la it milla dekayyeyma kame teshuva. vekol shekken i kabbil onsheh kedavid malka. amar ribbi yose, tanenan, kol man dechav veitperash mehahu chova, teshuva ka mealleyay leh tefe. vei lav, la salik bideh teshuva, vela mealleyay leh. i hachi, david hech la itperash mibbat sheva levatar. amar leh, bat sheva dideh havat, vedideh natil, deha mit balah.

Detanya, izdammenat havat bat sheva ledavid, miyyoma deitbere alma, uma akkeva leh. denatal berateh deshaul malka, vehahu yoma natal lah uriyya berachame, af al gav dela havat dileh. levatar ata david, venatil dileh, veal dedavid dachik shaata kame kudesha berich hu lekatla leuriyya ulemebad hachi. avish kameh, veanash leh ledavid, deha kudesha berich hu baa leatava leh ledavid, lekayyeyma leh malchuta kaddisha illaa. vechad taav, ledideh taav.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, may dichtiv ani Adonai. ani Adonai: atid litten sachar tov latzaddikim leatid lavo. ani Adonai atid lehippara min harshaim leatid lavo. innun dichtiv behu (Yeshayahu 66:24) happoshim bi. ketiv ani Adonai, uchetiv (Devarim 32:39) ani amit vaachayye. af al pi
1190: Sheani bemiddat harachamim, harshaim hofchim oti lemiddat hadin. detanya, shem male: Adonai elohim. zachu Adonai, vei lav elohim. amar ribbi shimon, chayyayvin avde pegimuta leella. may pegimuta. kema deokimna pegimuta mammash, veha ittemar.

Tana ketiv veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah, tane ribbi yehuda, dara deribbi shimon ben yochay share begavvih, kullehu zakkain, chasidin, kullehu dachale chattaa ninhu. shechinta sharya benayyhu, ma delet ken bedarin ochoranin. begine kach millin innun mitparshan, vela ittammeran. bedarin ochoranin lav hachi, umillin deraze illaa la yachlin legallaa, veinnun deyade mistafu. derabbi shimon kad hava amar raza dehay kera, chavrayyay kullehu enehon navin dimin, vechulhu millin deamar havo beenayyhu galyayn, kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:8) pe el pe adabber bo umare velo vechidot.

Deyoma chad shail ribbi yesa amar, bea dekusheta (sefer acher dekuseta), denafka meofa desharya (sefer acher deshade) benura, veitbaka learba sitrin. teren sallekin minnayyhu, vechad maich, vechad revia birvia (sefer acher nabeyay nevia) deyamma rabba. amar ribbi abba, avdat kammeh derabbi shimon, kodesh chol, deha ketiv pe el pe adabber bo. amar leh rabbi shimon, ad la yitbeka bea, (Shemot sefer acher amud bet, 174 amud alef) tistallak mealma. vechach hava beiddara derabbi shimon.
Tana, beyomoy derabbi shimon hava amar bar nash lechavreh, petach picha veyairu devarecha. batar deshachiv rabbi shimon, havo amre (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha.

Tanya amar rabbi shimon, i bene alma mistakkelan bema dichtiv beorayyta, la yetun leargaza kame marehon. tana, kad mitarin dinin kashyayn leachata bealma, veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah vegomer, hacha ketiv (tehillim ko) sod Adonai lireav, (290 amud bet vabeaderaa sefer acher uvehay dara) uveidara kaddisha ittemar, hacha itzterichna legallaa, deha laatar da istallak.

Detanenan, beshaata dechivya takkifa dilella ittear, begin chove alma, share veitchabbar im nukeba, veatil bah zuhama, itperash dechura minnah, begin deha isteavat, veitkeriat misava, vela itchaze lidchura lemikrav bahadah, devavy i isteav hu bahadah, bezimna deihi isteavat.

Vetana, (tissa 192) mea veesrin vachamesh zine mesaavuta nachtu lealma, demitachadan missitra dechivya takkifa, veshiva veesrin ravrevin minnayyhu, mitachadan benukeve, veitdabbekan behu. vavy leman deyikrav bahadah behahu zimna, deman deyikrav bahadah, achze pegimuta leella, deha bechova da, ittear chivya takkifa leella, veashde zuhama baatar dela itzterich, veitchabbar benukeba, veitrabbe saareh lidchura, benukeba isteavat, vesaraha rabba, vetuferaha sagiu, ucheden dinin sharyayn leitteara bealma, veyistaavun kolla. hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:20) ki et mikdash Adonai timme, mikdash Adonai isteav, bechovayyhu divne nasha.

Tana, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:15) veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha, arbaa veesrim zine mesaavuta attil chivya benukeba, kad itchabbar immah, kechusheban veeva, veesrin ved zinin (sefer acher dinin) mitarin leella, veesrin vearba letatta. vesaara rabba, vetuferin segiu, ucheden dinin mitarin becholla. vetana kad baat itteta leitdakkea, baya lesappera hahu saara derabbe beyoma deihi misava, ulesappera tuferaha, vechol hahu zuhama di behon.

Detana beraze dimsaavuta, zuhama detuferin, yittear zuhama ochora, uvegine kach, bayayn geniza, uman deabar lon legamre, keillu ittear chesed bealma. detanya la live leh leinish lemehav ducherana lezinin bishin. detanenan (77 amud alef) elaf vearba mea vaAdonai zinin bishin, mitachadan behahu zuhama, deatil chivya takkifa, vechullehu mitarin behahu zuhama detuferin.
Vaafillu man devae, yavid behu charshin livne nasha, mishshum innun detalyayn behu, uman deabar
1191: Lon, keillu asge chesed bealma, vedinin bishin la mishtakkechin. veyyabar hahu zuhama vetuferaha derashim beh. detanya, man dedarich beragleh, o bimsaneh alayyhu, yachil leitzeka. uma behay shiyyure deshiyyure dezuhama dilella kach, itteta dimkabbela veitchabbarat bechivya, veatil bah zuhama, al achat kamma vechamma. vavy lealma dimkabbela minnah mehahu zuhama, begine kach veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav.

Amar ribbi shimon, amar kudesha berich hu, haviu alay kappara berosh chodesh. alay vadday, begin deyitabbar hahu chivya, veyitbasam man devaya. alay: kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:2) serafim omdim mimmaal lo. veal da ketiv bekorach, (Bamidbar 16) hannoadim al Adonai, divginehon itar man deitar deate misitrayyhu. uf hacha haviu alay kafara, alay mamash. begin deyitbesam veyitavar vela ishtechach chivya baatar deshare. vekol kach lamma. al shemmiatti et hayyareach, veshalta bah man dela itzterich. uvegin kach ketiv veel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav.

Zakkaa dara, derabbi shimon ben yochay share begavvih. zakkaa adveh ben illain vetattain. aleh ketiv, (Kohelet 10:17) ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin. mahu ben chorin. dezakif resha legallaa, ulefarsha millin vela dachil. kehay deihu ben chorin, veyemma may devaya vela dachil. mahu malkech. da hu ribbi shimon ben yochay, mareh deorayyta, mareh dechachmeta. dechad hava ribbi abba vechavrayyay chaman leribbi shimon, havo rahate avatreh, veamre, (Hoshea 10) achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag.

Amar ribbi shimon, ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato, amay shakil da beda. ella kolla bechad darga seliku, da izdevvavg beda. vechedvavta deda beda la ishtechach, ella kad itgele attika kaddisha, ucheden chedvavta decholla. vetanenan, ketiv (Tehillim 92:1) mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, leyom hashabbat mammash. shevacha deka meshabbach kudesha berich hu. keden chedavavta ishtechach, venishmeta ittosefet. deha attika itgele veziuuga yizdaman.

Uf hachi bechadtute sihara, deha nahir lah shimsha bechedvavta dinhiru deattika leella. begine kach hay karbena hu leella, begin deyitbesam kolla, veyishtekach chedvavta bealma, veal da haviu alay kappara, dayyka milla.

Tana, ketiv (Bamidbar 28:10) olat shabbat beshabbato al olat hattamid, devae lechavvevna libba leella leella, yattir mishshear yomin. veal da al olat hattamid dayyka. tanya, ketiv bechanna (Shmuel 1 1) vattitpallel al Adonai, al dayyka, begin divnin bemazzala kaddisha talyayn, kema deokimna velet lach milla beorayyta, o at zeera beorayyta. dela remiza bechachmeta illaa, vetalyayn minneh tile talin razin dechachmeta illaa, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:11) kevutztzotav taltallim, veha ittemar.

Ribbi yose ashkacheh leribbi abba, dehava yativ vekari, hay kera dichtiv, (Tehillim 55:23) hashelech al Adonai yehavcha, al dayyka, deha mezone bemazzala talyayn. ribbi yehuda hava kare, (Tehillim 32:6) al zot yitpallel kol chasid elecha leet metzo. al zot vadday. leet metzo, ha okimna. aval leet metzo, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:6) dirshu Adonai behimatzo kerauhu bihyoto karov. davar acher leet metzo, beshaata denaharin nagdin veitmashchan, umistappeke avahan, umitbarchan kola. rak leshetef maym rabbim, man shetef maym rabbim, da amika demabbuin venaharin, deman yizke leh, uman yizke lekarva ulesalleka tamman. hada hu dichtiv beh, (Tehillim 32:6) rak leshetef mayim rabbim elav lo yaggio deha la zakkaan, vela yachlin.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Tehillim 27:4) achat shaalti meet Adonai otah avakkesh vegomer. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dechamma genizin illain temirin lehu behahu alma, dekudesha berich hu mishtaashea behu beinun almin, kema deokimna benoam Adonai, veha ittemar. ribbi chizkiyya amar mehacha, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. yaase, taase mibbae leh. ella yaase vadday, hayeynu (Yeshayahu 38:5) yosif al yamecha chamesh esre shana. vehayeynu hashelech al Adonai yehavcha. uchetiv vattitpallel al Adonai. vecholla chad.
Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, bealma den uvealma
1192: Deate, alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim Adonai:12) veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu vetasech alemo veyaletzu vecha ohave shemecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 9:11) veyivtechu vecha yode shemecha ki lo azavta dorshecha Adonai. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1193: Roim, illen innun madbere umanhige lebar nash bagehinnam. lo yadu sava, kema deat amer (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav, begin kach deinnun hav hav, la yadu sava. kullam ledarkam panu ish levitzo mikkatzehu. deha tayyayre degehinnam innun. vechol da man garim lehu. begin dela itkaddashu behahu ziuuga kema deitzterich. veal da ketiv, kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkol shear ammin la rayati leadbeka bi, ella yisrael, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai, attun, vela shear ammin. (veal da ketiv hacha kadosh) begin kach, (kedoshim tihyu dayyka).

(Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Yeshayahu 18:1) hoy eretz tziltzal kenafayim vegomer. vechi begin dehi eretz tziltzal kenafayim, kintura beh ishtechach, dichtiv hoy eretz. ella amar ribbi yitzchak, beshaata dekudesha berich hu bara alma, uvaa legallaa amikta miggo mesatterata, unehora miggo chashocha, havo kelilan da beda, uvegin kach, miggo chashocha nafak nehora, umiggo mesatterata, nafak veitgalyay amika, veda nafka min da. demiggo tav, nafik bish. umiggo rachame, nafik dina. vecholla itkelil da beda. yetzer tov veyetzer ra, yemina usemala, yisrael ushear ammin, chivvavr veucham, vecholla chad bechad talya.

Tana amar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehuda, kol alma kullehu la itchaze, ella bechad atira dekutefa (sefer acher dakeyzetavepaa) bekitroy kad ittedan alma bedina kalil berachame ittedan. vei lav, la yachil alma lekayyeyma, afillu riga chada, veha okimna mille, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:9) ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel.

Vetana behahu zimna dedina talya bealma, vetzedek itattera bedinoy, kama mare degadpin mitare, lokovle mare dedina kashya, leshalletaa bealma. parsin gadpin mehay sitra, umehay sitra, leishtattecha (sefer acher leashgacha) bealma. keden mitarin gadpin lemifras lon, uleishtaava (nusach acher uleishtattefa) bedina kashya, veshatin bealma leavasha. keden ketiv, hoy eretz tziltzal kenafayim. amar ribbi yehuda, chamina bene alma bechatzifuta, bar inun zakkai keshot. uvegin kach, kivyachol, kola hachi ishtachach, ata leitdakkaa, mesayyin leh. ata leistaava, kema deokimna, venitmetem bam.

Ribbi yose hava azil beorcha, paga beh ribbi chiyyay, amar leh hay deukemuha chavrayyay, dichtiv beeli, (Shmuel 1 3:14) velachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper avon bet eli bezevach umincha ad olam. bezevach umincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora. amay. begin dedivre tora, sallekin al kol karbenin dealma. kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Vayikra 7:37) zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim, shakil orayyta lokovel kol karbenin dealma. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, dechol man deishtedal beorayyta, af al gav deitgezar aleh onsha milella, nicha leh mikkol karbenin veillavavn, vehahu onsha itkera. (uvegin delae bah lishmah, kudesha berich hu itpayyays bahadeh)

Veta chaze, la itdache bar nash lealmin, ella bemillin deorayyta. begine kach millin deorayyta la mekabbelin tumea, begin deihi (Mishlei 3) kayyeyma ledakkea leillen misave, veasuvta beorayyta ishtechach. dichtiv, rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha. vedachyuta ishtechach beorayyta, dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:10) yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad. may omedet laad. dekayyeyma tedira behahu dachyuta, vela itade minneh lealmin.

Amar leh yirat Adonai ketiv, vela tora. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, deha orayyta missitra digvura ka atyay. amar leh, umehatam nafka, mehacha nafka, dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai, uchetiv yirat Adonai tehora.
Veorayyta kedushsha itkere, dichtiv ki kadosh ani Adonai, veda orayyta, dehi shema kaddisha illaa. veal da,
1194: Man deishtedal bah itdache, ulevatar itkaddash, dichtiv kedoshim tihyu, kedoshim heyu la ketiv, ella tihyu. tihyu vadday. amar leh hachi hu, umikra ketiv, (Shemot 19:6) veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh, uchetiv elle haddevarim vegomer.

Tana, kedushsha deorayyta, kedushsha dislikat al kol kiddushin. ukedushsha dechachmeta illaa setima, salleka al kolla. amar leh lav orayyta bela chachmeta, velav chachmeta bela orayyta, vecholla bechad darga hu, vecholla chad, ella orayyta bechachma illaa ishtechachat, uva kayyeyma, uva itnetau sharshaha mikkol sitrin.

Ad dahavo azle, ashkachu chad bar nash, bilkinta dekuseta, (sefer acher balekaytanea dakeysechaa) rachiv al suseya, ashmit yedoy lechad anpa deilana. amar ribbi yose, hay hu dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. adam mekaddesh atzmo millematta, mekaddeshin oto millemala. hada hu dichtiv, kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai.

Tane ribbi abba, parsheta da kelala deorayyta hi, vechotama dekusheta degushepanka hi. befarsheta da itchaddashu razin illain deorayyta, beeser amiran, vegizrin veonashin, ufikkudin illain, dechad matan chavrayyay lefarsheta da, havo chaddan.

Amar ribbi abba, may tama parsheta daarayot, ufarsheta dikdoshim tihyu, semuchin da leda. ella hachi tana, kol man deistamar meillen eryayn, bikdushsha itavid vadday. vekol shekken i itkaddash bikdushsha demareh. veha attearu chavrayyay.

Ematay onatan decholla, leitkaddash bar nash. ta chaze, man devae leitkaddesha biruta demareh, la lishammesh ella mippalgut lelya veelach, o befalgut lelya. deha behahi shaata, kudesha berich hu ishtechach beginta deeden, ukedushsha illaa ittear, ucheden shaata hi leitkaddesha. hay lishar bene nasha, talmide chachamim deyadin orchoy deorayyta, befalgut lelya shaata dilhon lemekam lemile beorayyta, leizdavvevga bikkeneset yisrael, leshabbecha lishma kaddisha, lemalka kaddisha.

Belelya deshabbeta, diruta decholla ishtechach, ziuuga dilhon behahi shaata. leappaka reuta dekudesha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. veillen ikrun kaddishin, dichtiv kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim 1:3) vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim asher piryo yitten beitto vegomer.

Kedoshim tihyu, ribbi abba patach, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz, ta chaze, bechol ammin dealma, la itree behu kudesha berich hu, bar beyisrael bilchodayyhu, veavid lon amma yechidaa bealma, vekara lon goy echad kishmeh. veattar lon bechamma itrin, vechamma pikudin, leitattera behu. veal da tefilin deresha utefillin didroa, leitattera behu bar nash kegavvna dilella. uleishtakkecha chad shelim becholla.

Uvehahi shaata deitattar behu bar nash, veitkaddash behu, itavid shelim, veikre echad, deechad la ikre ella kad ihu shelim. uman defagim, la ikre echad. veal da kudesha berich hu ikre echad, bishlimu dechola, bishlimu daavahan, bishlimu dichneset yisrael. begin kach yisrael letatta ikrun echad. dechad bar nash anach tefilin, veitchappe bechissuyay demitzva, keden itattar beitrin kaddishin kegavvna delella, veikre echad.

Uvegine kach, lete echad, veyishtedal beechad. kudesha berich hu deihu echad, yishtedal beechad. deha let malka mishtaddal, ella bemay deitchaze leh. uvegin kach ketiv, (Iyov 23:13) vehu veechad umi yeshivennu, la share kudesha berich hu vela ishtechach ella beechad. beechad, echad mibbae leh ella beman deittekan bikdushsha illaa lemehevi chad. keden hu sharya beechad, vela baatar ochora.
Veematay ikre bar nash echad. beshaata deishtechach dechar venukeba, veitkaddash bikdushsha (sefer acher beitrin) illaa, veitkevavn leitkaddesha. veta chaze, bezimna
1195: Deishtechach bar nash beziuuga chad dechar venukeba, veitkavivn leitkaddesha kedka yeot. keden hu shelim, veikre echad bela pegimu.

Begine kach, bae bar nash lemechde leitteteh behahi shaata, lezammena lah biruta chada immeh. veyitkavvevnun tarvavyyhu kechad lehahi milla. vechad mishtakkeche tarvavyyhu kechad, keden kolla chad benafsha uvegufa. benafsha: leadbeka da beda biruta chada. uvegufa: kema deolifna devar nash dela nasiv, hu keman deitpelig, vechad mitchabberan dechar venukeba, keden itavidu chad gufa. ishtechach deinhu chad nafsha, vechad gufa, veikre bar nash echad. keden kudesha berich hu share beechad, veafkid rucha dikdushsha behahu echad.

Veillen ikrun benin dekudesha berich hu, kema deittemar. uvegine kach kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. zakkain innun yisrael dela okim milla da baatar ochora, ella beh mammash, dichtiv ki kadosh ani Adonai. begin leitdabbeka beh, vela beochora. veal da kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem.

(Vayikra 19:3) ish immo veaviv tirau vegomer. ha tanenan, defarsheta da kelala deorayyta. makkish dechilu deabba veima leshabbetotay. ella amar ribbi yose, kolla chad, man dedachil mehay, natir lehay.

Ish immo, akdim immo leaviv bidchilu may tama. kema deukemuha. aval imma delet reshu bidaha kol kach keaviv (sefer acher aval ta chaze immo da keneset yisrael uvegin dibba sharya yire veihi yirat Adonai itkere) akdim dechilu dilah.
Ribbi yitzchak amar, ma ketiv leella, kedoshim tihyu. ate bar nash leitkaddesha beitteteh kechad. mimman hu shevacha yattir behahi kedushsha. havi emma minukeba. begin kach ish immo veaviv tirau.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ish immo veaviv tirau, kehay gavvna, (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. uvaatar ochora, akdim shamayim laaretz. ella leachazaa detarvavyyhu kachada itavidu. uf hacha akdim imma leabba, uvaatar ochora akdim abba leimma, leachazaa detarvavyyhu kachada ishtadalu beh.

Veet shabbetotay tishmoru, shakil da leda, vecholla kachada ittekalu bematkela chad. dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) ushemartem et hashabbat ki kodesh hi lachem, uchetiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. ella chad leabba, vechad leimma. ketiv hacha ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru. uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 26:2) et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau. mahu mikdashi.

Raya mehemna ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru. pikkuda da, shakil da leda. shakil yekara deav veem, likara deshabbat. leabba akdim kavod, vehay ihu deamar kera, (Malachi 1:6) veim av ani ayye chevodi veim adonim ani ayyi morai. kevodi salik bechusheban eser amiran, 38 elohim deovada divreshit.

Uvechol atar (Mishlei 3:35) kavod chachamim yinchalu, veukemuha rabbanan, en kavod ella tora. begin deinnun lev elohim detora, yekara dileh. veillen (inun) chachamim deorayyta, chachamim bechachma, yartin hay kavod vela tippeshe, dealayyhu ittemar, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon. umenalan deman dela yada beorayyta ikre kesil, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:7) uchesil lo yavin et zot. veen zot, ella tora, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe.

Raya mehemana. begin dachalishata, patachna lefarsheta beillen pikudin, lemehevi meat ezer lach. ittakkaf bach, deha mashshiryayn dimtivtan atan legabbach, befikkuda batar da, deihu pikkuda lehaamid alecha melech leella. vekudesha berich hu yokim lach melech beillain vetattain bediukeneh. begin derabbanan dimtivta, alayyhu shechinta illaa vetattaa. vekudesha berich hu melech beemtztzaita, achid beillain vetattain hachi ant tehe bediukeneh, bera dileh, kum bikara demalka.
Kam raya mehemana, vesalik yedoy leella, veamar, yehe raava dilach illat haillot, deant mitalle meilluy leilluy, ad delet illuy. ella
1196: Kemashmao. tu mikdashi illen innun dimkaddeshe garmayyhu behahi shaata. kegavvna da, (Yechezkel 9:6) umimmikdashi tachellu. al tikre mimmikdashi, ella mimmekuddashay. ma lehallan mimmekuddashay, af kan mimmekuddashay, deinnun abba veimma.

(Vayikra 19:3) ish immo veaviv tirau. rabbi shimon amar, ketiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, demitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, (inun velo umin ovde kochavim umazzalot) uvegin deinnun mitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, kolla itdevaku kachada da beda.

Ta chaze, beshaata debar nash mekaddesh letatta, kegon chavrayyay dimkaddeshe garmayyhu mishshabbat leshabbat, beshaata deziuuga illaa ishtechach, deha behahi shaata raava ishtechach, uvirchata izdammenat. keden mitdabbekan kullehu kechad, nafsha deshabbat, vegufa deizdeman beshabbat. veal da ketiv, ish immo veaviv tirau, deinnun ziuuga chad begufa, behahi shaata (leitkaddesha) deitkaddesha. veet shabbetotay tishmoru. da shabbat illaa veshabbat tattaa, deinnun mezammene lenafsha behahu gufa, mehahu ziuuga illaa. veal da veet shabbetotay tishmoru, tere vecholla itdevak da beda, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Davar acher veet shabbetotay tishmoru, leazhara leinnun dimchakkan leziuugayyhu mishshabbat leshabbat, veha okimna, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay dimsarsan garmayyhu kol shear yomin, begin lemile beorayyta. veinnun mechakkan mishshabbat leshabbat. hada hu dichtiv asher yishmeru et shabbetotay, kema deat amer (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar. uvegin kach veet shabbetotay tishmoru. ish immo veaviv tirau, da gufa. veet shabbetotay tishmoru, da nafsha. vecholla itdevak da beda. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Deant leella mikkol illuy. lemehav li chela, lemebad reutach bedargin dilach, deinnun abba veimma, vaana bera dilhon. uveyichudach tarvavyyhu echad. veant shaklat dechilu deabba veima, lidchilu dilach, batar deant beemtztzaita chad, vela teren, bela shuttafu, af al gav deinnun chad beshuttafu dilach, aval annet chad bela shuttafu detinyayna. uvegin da ittemar bach, (Devarim 32:39) veen elohim immadi.

Hav li chela, leitteara bikarach bekadmita. ulevatar bikara deavi veimi devishmayya, deukemuha alayyhu, (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit. veukemuha mare matnitin, en aviv, ella kudesha berich hu. veen immo, ella keneset yisrael. vikara dilach abba chachma, dechalil eser sefirot mittatta dileh leella, vetarvavyyhu innun kuresyay safsal techotach likarach.

Vehachi takkinu, lemehevi katan laggadol mechabbed dilella minneh. abba, ihu chachma, halo av echad lechullanu, lemehevi meshamesh techotach, veant keter elyon al resheh. velet keter alach, velet elaha ochora. veimma, leshammesha leabba. deihu techoteh lemehevi kisse techoteh.

Vayyomer ihu, bechol maamar, ad telatin uteren, yehi ken, vayhi chen. veihi, avidat maamareh miyyad. uvegin deavidat maamareh vetztziuuye bela ikkuva kelal, 34 shevilin divhon itbere kol divreshit, ovada itkeriat kavod, (Tehillim 29:9) uvehechalo kullo omer kavod. (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. ayyi mekom kevodo lehaaritztzo.

Vetargum kevod aviv, yekara daavuhi. veda (tehillim 19) torat Adonai temima, alah ittemar (Mishlei 3) yekara hi veyisrael mippeninim. deitkeriu banim, bichlal ben uvat, missitra detiferet umalchut. deinnun ben uvat, yekara deaviv veimmo, lemebad tziuuyeh, vetztzivuy dileh, innun pikudin daase. veha ukemuha mare matnitin, yesh metztzuvve veose. uvegin kach ihu naase venishma. vehay ihu kavod deabba veima, ditztzavve livreh deyebad hache veihu avid miyyad, bela ikkuva kelal.

Veillat al kolla, ana bae leishtaddela bikarach, letakken middot deabba veimma, likarach. tehe beezri lesaddera kolla kedka yiot. veant tesader li, ulechol mare metivtan ella vetatta, umashshiryayn demalachin illain vetattain, lemehevi metakkenin umesadderin likara dilach, velikara deabba veimma, lemehevi safsal techot ragloy. ulemebad tziuuyeh bechol pikudin dileh. ulemidchal minneh bechol pikudin dela taase.
1197: Ish immo veaviv tirau, vesamich leh veet shabbetotay tishmoru. uvikra acharina veet mitztzevotay taasu. missitra defikkudin daase deinnun kavod, akdim abba leimma, veda 15. missitra dela taase, akdim imma leabba, veda he. vehayeynu kevod elohim haseter davar. leillen dela mishtaddele behay kavod, haseter davar minnayyhu.

Vealayyhu ittemar, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon. illen innun amme haaretz, batar dela mishtaddelin behay kavod deorayyta, veech amrin avinu shebbashshamayim shema kolenu chus verachem alenu vekabbel tefillatenu. ha ihu lemma lon, veim av ani ayye chevodi, ayyi ishtaddeluta dilchon beorayyta, uvefikkudin dili, lemebad tziuuyay, deman dela yada betztziuuyay demareh, ech yavid leh.

Bar mimman deshama mechachamim veavid, vehay ihu dekabbil naase venishma. veim kol da, man dela kabbil mimmareh, ella mishlucheh, ikka afrashuta. umay afrashuta it ben da leda. deha ketiv, moshe kibbel tora missinay, ulevatar umesarah lihoshua. ana kabbilna, ulevatar mosarna lechullehu. vehachi man dimkabbel meochora, kekabbalat sihara vechochavayyay mishshimmesha, uvehay kibbul itmele. uman dimkabbel yachil leistalleka minneh neviu, kema dachazena beshimsha vesihara, deistallekat nehora dilhon, belelya, dela nahir shimsha, ella bimama. vesihara belelya.

Vei tema dehahu nehora desihara mishshimmesha ihu, deaf al gav deitkenish, nahir besihara vechochavayya, ha chazenan missitra ochora belakuta desihara veshimmesha deistellak nehorayyhu, veishtaaru kegufa bela nishmeta, deit adon alehem machashich meorehem. aval ikkara dinhora, hahu atar dinvia delet pesak linhora dileh, vela it aleh elaha ochora lemifsak minneh nehoreh.

Veillat haillot, batar deant tamman, let pesak linviu dinhora deorayyta. yehe raava dilach dela tazuz meabba veimma dili, vela mibbenoy. vehachi man deamit garmeh al orayyta, dehi yekara, itkayyeymat beh, vela mafsekat minneh. ma delav hachi, man dela yishtaddel ba, ella af al gav deavad tziuuy chachamim, ihu shammash dilhon, eved vela ben, aval i ihu mehemana, mareh ashlit leh bechol dileh.

Aval man dela ishtedal beorayyta, vela meshammesh chachamim, lemishma minnayyhu pikudin, lekayyem naase venishma. ella dessarach veavar al lo taase, ihu shakil leumin dealma ovde avoda zara, benoy desamael venachash, deittemar behu, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon, dela bau lekabbela orayyta, dechol delet beh tora, let beh kavod, deittemar bahem (Mishlei 3:35) kavod chachamim yinchalu.

Veim kol da mare metivta, la kol kavod shav, deha (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav. ben yechabbed, al menat dela lekabbela agra, aval metztzuvve hu bichvod abba veimma. vei la bae lemebad tziuuyeh, yichtash leh abba veimma, ad deyaavid al karcheh. vei havi bera ravreva, bet din kofin leh. dei la bae lemebad ma ketiv beh, (Devarim 21:20) benenu ze sorer umore enennu shomea bekolenu, vedanin leh biskila. aval eved dimshammesh al menat lekabbel peras, i la avid tziuuyeh derabbeh, mareh abar leh miggo beteh, veyitol ochora. ma dela hava yachil lemebad hachi livreh, ella o yaved tziuuyeh o yiktol leh.

Amar leh butztzina kaddisha, man garim dela yaved tziuuyeh, hoil uvereh hu. amar raya mehemana, vadday taarovet dera, veraza da garam leyisrael, lemechete gabbe avuhon devishmayya. veraza da, (Tehillim 106:35) vayyitarvu vaggoyim. veda garam kitula leyisrael, vechariv be makdesha. uvegin da, en mekabbelim gerim limot hammashiach, ella (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar.

Deyisrael innun meilana dechayyi, eved tov veeved ra, missitra dimtatron eved tov, eved neeman lerabbeh. eved ra samael. man deihu meilana dechayyi, ihu ben holam habba, ben missitra deven yah, bina. veyarit malchuta deihi Adonai. veech yarit lah. i avid tziuuyeh deabba veima, begin deihu malchuta mitztzevat hammelech, vealeh ittemar, (Ester 3:3) maddua atta over et mitztzevat hammelech. ihi mitztzeva, vetztziuuyay demalka al ase velo taase.

Mitztzeva middeorayyta, deihi tiferet. vehacha let tamman piruda, kudesha berich hu emet, torato torat emet, ihu torato umitztzevato. kegavvna devina, torato umitztzevato dechachma. deit tora divria, vechachma divria, uvina divria, vehachi bechol middot. behay, yachil ben behay orayyta, lemehevi bela mitztzeva, umitztzeva bela tora beferuda. umehacha,
1198: Ben sorer umore. aval missitra daatztzilut, let afreshuta, tamman, vechen mittamman en chet ba al yado velet bah onesh vela sachar vela mita.

Uvegin da, orayyta da ilana dechayyi, sechar haolam habba, veilana da, ilana dechayye itkere, veitkere haolam habba, vela itkere beh sachar. begin deihu ben. mittamman, la ishtedal beorayyta lekabbela agra, la bemaase vela bedibbur vela bemachashava.

Ata butztzina kaddisha, lenashsheka leh yedeh. amar, vadday ant hu ben mittamman, bediyyukena divra buchera dileh, tiferet bera deabba veima illaa, atztzilut dileh bela hafesaka, la kedamach bera ochora, la bemachashava, vela bedibbur, vela bemaase. amar raya mehemana, veant, vechavrayyay, verashe mare metivtan, dimzammenin hacha, itti, bela hafesaka kelal, uvela taarovet. nashku kullehu da leda, veishtemodau beachva, uvachu.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, im kol da, bera buchera chayyayvin kol achuy bikareh, deha ketiv (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha, veukemuha rabbanan, et lerabbot achich haggadol. vaafillu mikkol sitra ihu meforash alach beorayyta, beshaggam ze hevel. vela hava leadam kadmaa bera kadmaa minneh, veukemuha rabbanan, beshaggam, ze moshe. dibbera demalka bechol atar, ant buchera missitra deilana dechayye detov vara, ant hu tov. (buchera) hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayar elohim et haor ki tov, (Shemot 2:25) vattere oto ki tov hu.

Umittamman kara yatach kudesha berich hu eved neeman. levatar selikat lemehevi malka, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:5) vayhi vishurun melech. levatar ben bayit leella. melech missitra demalchut divria. ben bayit, missitra devina divria. kean ant melech, missitra deilana demalchut daatztzilut. ben bayit, missitra deven yah, tiferet daatztzilut, zakkaa chulakach. uman garim lach da, begin deishtedalutach battora uvamitztzeva, leyachada kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, leaala malka al atreh, veal mashiryayteh leella, veal yisrael letatta.

Uvegin kach (sefer acher vabegaynach) yartin kullehu nishmatin daatztzilut minneh, veitkeriu benin dileh, mishem Adonai daatztzilut, delet tamman pirud vekitztzutz. divkadmeta ittemar behu benin lekudesha berich hu ushechinteh, mitztzad Adonai divria, deittemar beh berativ yetztzartiv af asitiv, uchean banim laydod daatztzilut.

Uvach itkayyaym pikkuda, deihi mitztzeva al yisrael, lehaamid alehem melech. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 17:15) som tasim alecha melech. veitkayyaym bach (Devarim 33:5) vayhi vishurun melech, kad bekadmita. vechullehu mitnahagin avatrach, kaevarin demitnahagin kullehu bitnua denishmeta, deitpashsheta al kol ever. begin decheter elyon ant tehe meutar beh, deveh illat haillot ihu keter al kolla, tamir veganiz millegav minneh. uminneh itpeshat al kol sefiran, umesadder lon lemehevi da rav, veda zeer, veda benoni, veanhig lon liruteh, venahir behu, umekasher lon, umeyached lon.

Hachi ant tehe manhig leyisrael, bechol middot tavin dileh, utesadder kol chad kidchaze leh, habbechor kivchorato, vehatztzair kitztzeiruto, uvenoni kefum dargeh. utekasher lon kesher echad legabbe avuhon devishmayya. lemehevi kullehu besafa berura, levarcha lekudesha berich hu. ulekaddesheh, uleyaychadeh, bedarga dilach, bemachashava dilach, baatztzilut dilach, deitkayyaym bach (Bamidbar 11:17) veatztzalti min haruach asher alecha vesamti alehem. kum ittear befikkuda, lehacherit zaro shel amalek. (parashat tetze 281 amud bet shayych linnase 145 amud alef)

(Vayikra 19:3) ish immo veaviv tirau vegomer pikkuda da, lechabbed av veem, deitztzetrich bar nash lemidchal meavoy umeimeh, uleokir lon. kema deitztzetrich bar nash leokir leh lekudesha berich hu. missitra derucha deyahav begavih. ulemidchal minneh. hachi itztzetrich leh leokir laavoy uleimmeh, missitra degufa dileh, ulemidchal minnehon, deha innun mishtattefin bekudesha berich hu, veavde leh gufa, vehoil veinnun shuttafin beovada, lihevu shuttafin bidchilu vikara.

Kegavvna da, 3 shuttafin ishtechachu leella beraza deadam. adam kadmaa, af al gav degufa dileh hava meafra, lav meafra dehacha hava ella meafra deve makdesha dilella. abba veimma ishtechachu, umalka illaa ishtetaf bahadayyhu, veshadar beh rucha dechayyi, veitbere. uchegavvna da, ishtekach kolla ella vetatta. veal da itztzetrich leh lebar nash lemidchal lekudesha berich hu, ulemidchal laavuy uleimmeh.

Besitre tora, adam kadmaa la hava leh mehay alma kelum. chad tzaddik avad shimmusha benukeveh, veitavid mehahu shimmusha gufa chada, dinhiru dileh yatir mikkol innun malachin shelichan leella. vechad itbere hahu gufa malka illaa, shadar behahu tzadik 22 atvavn, veishtetaf bahadayyhu, venafak lealma.
Kevan denafak, chamu leh shimsha vesihara, veastimu
1199: Nehorayyhu, detappucha deragleh achshich nehora dilhon. may taama. begin demeovada deshimsha vesihara illaa nafak. kevan dechata, itchashach, veazir garmeh, veitztzetrich legufa ochora bemishcha uvevisra. dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:21) vayyaas Adonai elohim laadam uleishto katnot or vayyalbishem. kehahu shimmusha daavad hahu tzadik benukeveh, la ishtechach mikkadmat dena, ulevattar dena, deha ad la nafak letztzoref umana.

Ad deata chanoch, venatil leh kudesha berich hu meara, veavrir pesolet vekastura mikkasfa, vechen bechol innun tzaddikayyay di beara. levatar ittakkan hahu atar, veitavidu ruchin venishmatin beshimmushayyhu vegufa mittatta beara. veal da beshuttafu dilella vetatta, bar nash ate lealma, veitztzetrich lemidchal leinnun shuttafin, uleokir lon, kema deittemar (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 19:4) al tifnu el haelilim vilohe massecha lo taasu lachem. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Devarim 9:27) al tefen el keshi haam hazze vegomer. al tefen. vechi man hu deyemma lemalka, al tefen. veha ketiv (Iyov 34:21) ki enav al darche ish. uchetiv (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bamistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai, veha becholla ashgach kudesha berich hu vechol ovadin mistakkal, veayil bedina al kullehu, im tav veim bish, kema deat amer, (Kohelet 12:14) haelohim yavi vemishpat al kol nelam im tov veim ra. umoshe amar al tefen.

Ella, kama bae bar nash leistammera mechovoy, begin dela yechote kame malka kaddisha. ta chaze, bar nash deavid mitzva, hahi mitzva salleka, vekayyeyma kame kudesha berich hu, veamra ana mippelanyay deavad li. vekudesha berich hu mane lah kammeh, leashgecha bah kol yoma leotava leh beginah. avar al pitgame orayyta, hahi avera salleka kameh, veamra ana mippelanyay daavad li, vekudesha berich hu mane lah, vekayyeyma tamman leashgecha bah, leshetzaa leh. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:19) vayyar Adonai vayinatz mikkaas banav uvenotav. mahu vayyar. hahu dekayyeyma kammeh.

Tav bitshuva, ma ketiv. (Shmuel 2 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut. deabar hahu chova mikkammeh, begin dela yistakkal beh. leotava leh. veal da al tefen el keshi haam hazze veel risho veel chattato. amar ribbi yose, vechen mehacha mashma, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) nichtam avonech lefanay.

Ribbi yose zeera, al kameh deribbi shimon yoma chad, ashkecheh dehava yativ vekaari, ketiv, (Bereshit 3:12) vayyomer haadam haishsha asher natatta immadi hi natna li min haetz vaochel. mashma deadam vechavva kachada itberiu, uvegufa chada. dichtiv asher natatta immadi, vela ketiv asher natatta li, amar leh, i hachi, vehakketiv (Shmuel 1 1:26) ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha baze. vela ketiv hannitztzevet lefanecha. amar leh, i ketiv hannittenet immecha, hava amena hache, kedichtiv asher natatta immadi, aval hannitztzevet ketiv.

Amar leh, veha ketiv (Bereshit 2:18) vayyomer Adonai elohim lo tov heyot haadam levaddo eese lo ezer kenegdo. eese lo hasheta. amar leh hachi hu vday, deadam levaddo hava, dela hava leh semech minnukeveh, begin dahavat besitroy kema deokimna. uma deamar eese lo ezer, hachi hu, dela ketiv evra lo ezer, begin dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:2) zachar unekeva beraam. aval eese ketiv. umahu eese. ataken. mashma dekudesha berich hu natil lah missitroy, vetakin lah betikkuna, veayyte lah kammeh. ucheden ishtammash adam beinteteh, vahava leh semech.

Vetanenan, shepiru deadam kadtira dekitra illaa, mizzihara denahara. shepiru dechavva, dela havo yachlin kol biryayn leistakkela bah. vaafillu adam la hava istekal bah, ad hahu zimna dechavu, veadiat (sefer acher vaazaayret) shepiru dilhon. keden istakkal bah adam, veishtemoda bah leshammesha bah. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 4:25) vayyeda adam od et ishto. vayyeda: becholla. vayyeda: betashmish. vayyeda: deishtemoda bah veistakkal bah.
Vetanenan, asir leh lebar nash leistakkela bishpiru deinteta, begin dela yete behirhura bisha, veyitakkar
